blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pretrained models for cell and nuclear instance segmentation differ substantially in architecture, pretraining data and objectives, parameter count, inference strategy, adaptation requirements, postprocessing pipeline, and computational demand. Large pretrained and foundation models are increasingly adopted because of their strong zero-shot capabilities, but their use also imposes greater energy consumption, memory requirements, computational demands, adaptation costs, and operational carbon emissions. Whether these additional demands are justified by meaningful gains in segmentation performance remains unclear. We address this question by introducing the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI), a configurable metric that combines segmentation performance, energy consumption, and model size. We benchmark 19 pretrained and foundation models across six CellBinDB datasets under zero-shot inference and evaluate 16 fine-tunable models using few-shot adaptation with both frozen encoder and full-model fine-tuning. We estimate energy consumption for GPU, CPU, and RAM using software-based monitoring tools. Our results show that larger and more computationally demanding models do not consistently achieve proportionate improvements in segmentation quality. While few-shot adaptation benefits several models, the gains and resource costs vary considerably across architectures, datasets, and adaptation strategies, causing SAPI-based rankings to differ from rankings based on performance alone. This study provides a practical framework for comparing segmentation models more comprehensively and supports more computationally accessible and environmentally responsible model selection in biomedical image analysis.
blocks.zh: 细胞和核实例分解的预先训练模型在结构、培训前数据和目标、参数计数、推断战略、适应要求、处理后管道和计算需求等方面差异很大。 大型的预先培训和基础模型因其强大的零射能力而日益被采用,但是其使用也带来了更大的能量消耗,内存要求,计算需求,适应成本,以及运行中的碳排放. 这些额外要求是否以在分解业绩方面取得有意义的进展为理由,仍然不清楚。 我们通过采用可持续性-意识到性能指数来解决这一问题,这是一个可描述的衡量标准,将分化性能、能耗和模型规模结合起来。 我们把19个预先训练的模型和基础模型作为基准,在零射线推论下覆盖6个CellBinDB数据集,并使用冷冻编码器和全模型的微调,使用几射线改造方法评价16个微调模型。 我们使用基于软件的监测工具估算GPU,CPU和RAM的能量消耗. 我们的结果表明,规模更大、计算要求更高的模型无法始终如一地在分化质量方面取得相称的改进。 虽然少见的适应有利于几个模型,但不同架构、数据集和适应战略的收益和资源成本差异很大,导致基于SAPI的排名与仅基于绩效的排名不同。 本研究为更全面地比较分解模型提供了一个实用框架,并支持生物医学图像分析中更具计算方便性和对环境负责的模型选择.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cell and nucleus instance segmentation is a foundational step in quantitative microscopy because many downstream analyses require individual objects to be identified and delineated. Reliable object instance boundaries enable cell counting, morphometric measurement, phenotypic profiling, spatial analysis of cell populations, and the assignment of molecular signals to individual cells. In digital pathology, nuclear segmentation supports the extraction of interpretable cellular features and the characterization of tissue architecture; in multiplex tissue imaging, whole-cell and nuclear masks convert spatially resolved marker measurements into cell-level data; and in experimental biology, segmentation underpins high-content assays in which large image collections must be transformed into reproducible quantitative readouts. These applications span basic cell biology, computational pathology, spatial omics, drug discovery, and biopharmaceutical development, but they share the same practical requirement: segmentation must remain reliable across variation in tissue, staining chemistry, imaging modality, cell morphology, object density, and image quality. Errors introduced at this stage propagate into subsequent measurements, making segmentation quality consequential for the validity of the biological or clinical analysis constructed from the resulting instances [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 细胞和核实例分解是定量显微镜的一个基础步骤,因为许多下游分析需要识别和划定单个物体. 可靠的物体实例边界可以使细胞计数,尸检测量,间皮剖析,细胞群的空间分析,以及分子信号分配给单个细胞. 在数字病理学中,核分化支持取出可解释的细胞特征和组织结构的特征;在多子组织成像中,全细胞和核口罩将空间解析的标记测量转换为细胞一级数据;在实验生物学中,分化支撑了高含量的化验,即大型图像集必须转换为可再生的定量读取. 这些应用跨越了基本的细胞生物学,计算病理学,空间相学,药物发现和生药开发,但它们具有相同的实际要求:分化必须保持组织变化,污化化学,成像模式,细胞形态,物体密度,和图像质量等各方面的可靠性. 这一阶段引入的错误会传播到以后的测量中,使分解质量对由此产生的生物或临床分析的有效性产生影响。

blocks.en: Cell and nucleus segmentation was initially approached through classical image-processing pipelines that combined intensity thresholding, filtering, morphological operations, contour detection, distance transforms, and watershed-based separation. These methods were often computationally efficient and interpretable, but their performance depended strongly on manually selected parameters and assumptions about image contrast, object shape, and boundary visibility. Variations in staining, illumination, noise, cell morphology, and object density could therefore require extensive retuning and limit transfer across datasets. Deep convolutional neural networks changed this paradigm by learning hierarchical image representations directly from annotated data and combining contextual encoding with precise spatial localization, as demonstrated by the encoder–-decoder architecture and skip connections introduced in U-Net [ 2 ] . Once reliable pixel-level prediction became possible, subsequent work increasingly addressed the more difficult problem of converting foreground predictions into distinct cellular instances. Convolutional architectures therefore incorporated object-centered geometric representations [ 3 ] , learned displacement fields [ 4 ] , and dedicated output branches to distinguish adjoining or overlapping nuclei in crowded microscopy and histopathology images [ 5 ] . These developments moved instance segmentation beyond generic foreground classification by allowing object shape, relative pixel position, and instance boundaries to be learned as part of the prediction task. The next major architectural shift arose with vision transformers, which represented images as sequences of patches and used self-attention to learn interactions among image regions, particularly when pre-trained on large image collections [ 6 ] . Transformer encoders were then incorporated into biomedical image segmentation architectures by combining pre-trained encoders with task-specific decoders for cell and nucleus delineation [ 7 ] . Large-scale promptable segmentation introduced a foundation-model paradigm in which a high-capacity image encoder trained on an extensive collection of images and masks, could support mask generation across varied image distributions and segmentation tasks [ 8 ] . This paradigm was then extended to microscopy by adapting foundation–model representations and segmentation interfaces to biological images and microscopy-specific annotation workflows [ 9 ] . This progression has culminated in large vision transformer–-based foundation models pre-trained on extensive and diverse image collections.
blocks.zh: 细胞和核分裂最初是通过古典图像处理管道进行的,这些管道结合了强度阈值、过滤、形态操作、轮廓探测、距离转换和以分水岭为基础的分离。 这些方法往往在计算上是高效和可解释的,但其性能强烈依赖于人工选择的参数和关于图像对比,对象形状,和边界能见度的假设. 因此,在污渍、发光、噪音、细胞形态和物体密度方面的变化可能需要进行广泛的再调整并限制跨数据集的转移。 深演化神经网络通过直接从注释数据中学习分级图像表现,将上下文编码与精确空间本地化相结合,从而改变了这个范式,这表现在编码器–解码器架构并跳过U-Net引入的连接[2]. 一旦可靠的像素水平预测成为可能,随后的工作将越来越多地解决将前地预测转换成独特的细胞实例这一更困难的问题。 因此,革命结构包含了以物体为中心的几何表示法[3],学习了异位字 [4],以及专门输出分支,在拥挤的显微镜和组织病理学图像中区分相邻或相重叠的核 [5]. 这些发展使得实例分解超越了一般的前地分类,因为可以将对象形状,相对像素位置和实例边界作为预测任务的一部分来学习. 接下来的主要建筑转变是视觉变换器,它代表了图象作为补丁的序列,并用自觉来学习图象区域之间的相互作用,特别是在对大型图象集进行预先训练时[6]. 变形器编码器随后被整合入生物医学图像分解架构中,将预先训练的编码器与特定任务解码器结合起来,用于细胞和核分解[7]. 大规模可快速分解引入了一种地基模型范式,在这种范式中,经过大量收集图像和口罩培训的高容量图像编码器可以支持不同图像分布和分解任务的口罩生成[8]. 这个范式后来被推广到显微镜上,将基础-模型表示和分块界面适应了生物影像和显微镜特定的注释工作流程[9]. 这一进步最终形成了大型视变器-基于地基的模型,预先在广泛而多样的图像收藏上进行了训练.

blocks.en: The practical appeal of pre-trained and foundation models lies in their ability to segment images from a new dataset without additional target-specific training. In this zero-shot setting, a model is applied using knowledge acquired during pre-training, thereby avoiding the time and annotation effort required to construct a new model for each imaging study. However, recent comparative evaluations indicate that zero-shot performance remains strongly dependent on the characteristics of the target data [ 10 ] . When zero-shot predictions do not provide sufficient accuracy, the pre-trained representation can instead serve as an initialization for adaptation to the target domain. Fine-tuning with a small support set of annotated target images allows the model to learn dataset-specific appearance and morphological characteristics without requiring the large annotation collections typically needed to train a segmentation network from scratch. Few-shot fine-tuning studies have shown that pre-trained models can be adapted using only a limited number of annotated samples from the target dataset, although the resulting performance depends on which images are selected for annotation and how well they represent the target distribution [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 预先培训的和基础模型的实际吸引力在于它们能够从一个新的数据集中分割图像,而无需额外的特定目标培训。 在这个零射入的设定中,一个模型被应用在预训期间获得的知识,从而避免了为每次成像研究构建出新模型所需的时间和注释努力. 然而,最近的比较评价表明,零发性能仍然在很大程度上取决于目标数据的特点[10]. 当零发预测不能提供足够的准确性时,被预先训练的表示可以代替为适应目标域的初始化. 用一小组附加说明的目标图像进行微调,使模型能够学习数据集特有的外观和形态特征,而不需要从零开始训练分块网络通常需要的大型注释集. 少有镜头的微调研究显示,经过预先训练的模型只能使用目标数据集中数量有限的附加说明的样本来调整,尽管由此产生的性能取决于选择哪些图像进行注释,以及它们代表目标分布的好坏[11].

blocks.en: The growing use of large pre-trained models has made the computational cost of artificial intelligence an increasingly important consideration alongside predictive performance. This concern motivated the emergence of Green AI, which argues that methodological progress should be evaluated not only by improvements in accuracy, but also by the computational resources required to develop and use a model [ 12 ] . Early empirical evidence from natural language processing showed that training, hyperparameter optimization, and repeated experimentation with large neural networks could entail substantial energy consumption, financial cost, and associated carbon emissions [ 13 ] . Subsequent analyses of large-scale neural network training further demonstrated that environmental impact is shaped not only by the amount of computation performed, but also by model architecture, hardware efficiency, data-centre infrastructure, and the carbon intensity of the electricity supply [ 14 ] . These findings led to calls for more systematic measurement and reporting of energy use and carbon emissions in machine-learning research, so that improvements in model quality can be interpreted in relation to the resources required to achieve them [ 15 ] . Accordingly, improvements in predictive performance should be interpreted together with the computational resources required to obtain them. This requires explicit consideration of the costs associated with model development, target-domain adaptation, and repeated inference, particularly when large pretrained models are intended for broad or sustained use.
blocks.zh: 人工智能的计算成本与预测性能一起成为日益重要的考虑因素。 这一关切促使Green AI的出现,认为方法进展不仅应通过提高准确性来评价,而且还应通过开发和使用模型所需的计算资源来评价[12]. 来自自然语言处理的早期经验证据表明,培训、超参数优化和对大型神经网络的反复试验可能涉及大量的能耗、财务成本和相关碳排放[13]。 随后对大规模神经网络培训的分析进一步表明,环境影响不仅取决于所进行计算的数量,而且还取决于模型结构、硬件效率、数据中心基础设施和电力供应的碳密度[14]。 这些结果导致要求在机器学习研究中更系统地衡量和报告能源使用和碳排放量,以便能根据实现这些目标所需的资源来解释模型质量的改进[15]。 因此,应结合获得预测性业绩所需的计算资源来解释预测性业绩的改善。 这就需要明确考虑模型开发、目标域调整和再三推论的相关成本,特别是在大型预先培训的模型意在广泛或持续使用的情况下。

blocks.en: Despite substantial progress in cell and nucleus instance segmentation, model evaluation remains dominated by predictive performance. Existing benchmarks compare segmentation accuracy across imaging modalities, tissues, and model families, but they provide limited evidence about the computational resources required to obtain and sustain that performance. This omission is increasingly important because contemporary segmentation methods differ markedly in model scale, inference requirements, and the amount of target-domain adaptation they require. A model that achieves the highest segmentation score may also consume considerably more energy during inference, require costly fine-tuning, or depend on hardware that is unavailable in many research and deployment settings. Conversely, a computationally efficient model may provide comparable performance at substantially lower operational cost. However, these trade-offs cannot be determined from accuracy, parameter count, or runtime alone. To our knowledge, no controlled benchmark has jointly evaluated zero-shot performance, few-shot adaptation, inference and fine-tuning energy, and model complexity across a diverse collection of specialist, generalist, and foundation models for cell and nucleus instance segmentation. As a result, it remains unclear whether the performance gains offered by larger pretrained models are proportionate to the additional resources required to adapt and deploy them. Addressing this gap is necessary to support model selection that reflects not only segmentation quality, but also computational accessibility, operational efficiency, and the practical requirements of the intended application.
blocks.zh: 尽管在细胞和核心实例分化方面取得了很大进展,但模型评价仍以预测性能为主。 现有的基准比较了成像模式、组织和模型家族的分化精度,但它们提供的关于获取和维持这种性能所需的计算资源的证据有限。 这一遗漏越来越重要,因为现代分化方法在模型尺度、推论要求以及它们所需要的目标领域适应量方面差异明显。 达到分化分数最高的模型在推论中也可能消耗更多的能量,需要昂贵的微调,或者依赖于许多研究和部署环境所不具备的硬件. 反之,计算效率高的模型可提供可比较的性能,但业务费用要低得多。 然而,这些取舍不能仅从准确性、参数计算或运行时间来确定。 据我们所知,没有一个可控基准能够联合评估零发性能,几发适应,推论和微调能量,以及模型复杂性,涵盖细胞和核实例分化的各种专家、通论和基础模型。 因此,目前仍不清楚的是,较大型的预先训练好的模型所提供的业绩收益是否与调整和部署这些模型所需的额外资源相称。 解决这一差距对于支持不仅反映分解质量,而且反映计算可用性、业务效率和预期应用的实际要求的模型选择是必要的。

blocks.en: Motivated by this gap, we ask whether the segmentation performance gains offered by larger pretrained and foundation models justify their additional inference energy, adaptation energy, and model complexity. To address this question, our study makes three main contributions. First, we conduct a controlled benchmark of 19 cell and nucleus instance-segmentation models across six CellBinDB datasets [ 10 ] covering DAPI, single-stranded DNA, multiplex immunofluorescence, and H&E imaging modalities, with 1,044 images distributed across 30 tissue types and containing over 100,000 annotated cell and nuclear instances. Specifically, we evaluate the models under zero-shot condition to determine the performance provided by their existing pretrained representations without target-domain optimization. For the 16 models with fine-tuning API available to us, we compare frozen-encoder and full-model fine-tuning using tissue-stratified few-shot support sets, thereby examining both the benefits and the computational costs of adapting pretrained models to unknown datasets. Second, we measure energy consumption (GPU, CPU, and RAM) during inference and fine-tuning on a fixed hardware using software based estimates, and quantify model complexity via total parameter count. Third, we introduce the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI), a configurable metric that associates segmentation performance with energy demand and model scale. Together, these contributions provide a unified framework for determining when additional model capacity and computational expenditure produce a proportionate improvement in segmentation performance.
blocks.zh: 基于这一差距,我们问,更大的预先培训和基础模型所提供的分化性能收益是否证明它们增加推论能量、适应能和模型复杂性是合理的。 为了解决这一问题,我们的研究作出了三个主要贡献。 首先,我们在六个细胞BinDB数据集[10]中进行19个细胞和核实例划分模型的可控基准,涵盖DAPI、单弦DNA、多子免疫荧光和H&E成像模式,在30个组织类型中分布了1,044个图像,包含超过10万个附加说明的细胞和核事件。 具体地说,我们评价零镜头条件下的模型,以确定它们现有的未经目标域优化预先训练的表示所提供的性能. 对于16个有微调的API, 我们比较了冷冻编码器和全模型的微调, 使用组织分级的几发支持集, 从而考察了将预先训练的模型适应未知数据集的好处和计算成本。 第二,我们利用基于软件的估计数,在推论和微调固定硬件时测量能耗(GPU、CPU和RAM),并通过总参数数量化模型复杂性。 第三,我们采用可持续性-智能性能指数(SAPI),这个可配置的衡量标准将分化性能与能源需求和模型规模联系起来。 这些贡献共同提供了一个统一的框架,用以确定何时额外的模型能力和计算支出可按比例改善分解业绩。

blocks.en: The broader objective is to make sustainability and computational accessibility integral components of methodological quality in cell and nuclear segmentation, rather than considerations introduced only after a model has been selected. This perspective does not imply that the smallest model is inherently preferable or that energy efficiency should take precedence over segmentation quality. Instead, additional computational demand should be justified by improvements that are meaningful for the intended application. This principle is relevant to high-throughput pathology, spatial molecular profiling, multiplex imaging, pharmaceutical screening, and academic research, where segmentation models may be applied repeatedly to large image collections under substantially different hardware, memory, and energy constraints. Resource-aware evidence can also strengthen reproducibility by revealing whether reported performance gains depend on computationally intensive adaptation or deployment conditions that may not be accessible across institutions. By jointly evaluating segmentation performance, adaptation requirements, operational energy consumption, and model scale, this study provides a basis for determining whether improvements in accuracy are proportionate to the resources required to achieve and sustain them. More broadly, it frames model selection as a balance among technical performance, generalizability, computational accessibility, and environmental responsibility. Such an approach can support the development and adoption of segmentation methods that are not only accurate, but also reproducible, practically feasible, and appropriate for the biological, clinical, or industrial setting in which they will be used.
blocks.zh: 更广泛的目标是使可持续能力和计算无障碍性成为细胞和核分裂方法质量的组成部分,而不是只在选定一个模型之后才加以考虑。 这种观点并不意味着最小的模型本来就更可取,或者能源效率应优先于分化质量。 相反,额外的计算需求应当以对预期应用有意义的改进为理由。 这一原则与高通量病理学,空间分子剖面,多子成像,药物筛选,和学术研究相关,在硬件,内存,能能的制约下,分化模型可以被反复地应用于大型图像采集. 了解资源的证据还可以通过披露报告的业绩收益是否取决于可能无法跨机构获取的计算密集适应或部署条件,从而加强可复制性。 本研究通过联合评价分解性能,适应性要求,运行能消耗,和模型规模,为确定精度提高是否与实现和保持精度所需的资源相称提供了依据. 更广泛地说,它将模型选择设定为技术性能、通用性、可计算性和环境责任之间的平衡。 这种方法可以支持开发和采用分化方法,这些方法不仅准确,而且可以复制、实际可行并适合生物、临床或工业环境。

blocks.en: Finally, the remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 describes the CellBinDB datasets and the model zoo, together with the segmentation performance metrics, energy measurement protocols, the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index, and the experimental study design. Section 3 presents the results of zero-shot and few-shot evaluations, including segmentation performance and energy consumption. Section 4 discusses the implications of our findings for sustainable model selection, and Section 5 concludes with a summary of the key findings.
blocks.zh: 最后,本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第2节介绍了CellBinDB数据集和模型动物园,以及分块性能度量表,能测协议,可持续性-智能性能指数和实验性研究设计. 第3节介绍了零发和零发评价的结果,包括分片性能和能耗。 第4节讨论了我们的调查结果对可持续模式选择的影响,第5节最后概述了主要调查结果。

blocks.en: We evaluate all models on the CellBinDB datasets [ 10 ] , which is a multimodal benchmark for cell instance segmentation that contains expert instance annotations across six imaging modalities. The collection combines in-house Stereo-seq acquisitions with publicly released 10xGenomics FFPE data, spanning four fluorescence modalities (multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF), single-stranded DNA (ssDNA), DAPI, and 10xGenomics_DAPI) and two haematoxylin–eosin modalities (HE and 10xGenomics_HE). In total, the datasets have 1,044 images containing 102,480 annotated cell instances, distributed across 30 distinct tissue types over the six modalities. Table 1 summarizes the composition of each dataset and Figure 1 shows one sample image with its reference mask from each dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了CellBinDB数据集上的所有模型[10],这是细胞实例分解的多模式基准,包含6个成像模式的专家实例说明. 该集将内部立体声学收购与公开发布的10xGenomics FFPE数据相结合,跨越了四种荧光学模式(多聚免疫流体(MIF),单弦DNA(ssDNA),DAPI和10xGenomics_DAPI)和两种血氧林-eosin模式(HE和10xGenomics_HE). 数据集共有1 044个图像,包含102 480个附加说明的细胞例,分布在六个模式的30个不同的组织类型。 表1汇总了每个数据集的构成,图1显示一个样本图像,并带有每个数据集的参考口罩.

blocks.en: We chose CellBinDB for three reasons. First, it spans several microscopy domains within a single resource that was consistently annotated, so the same evaluation protocol applies unchanged to every model and every domain. Second, none of the evaluated checkpoints was trained on CellBinDB, which makes it an independent test set for both zero-shot evaluation and target-specific adaptation. Third, it varies along the axes that drive the difficulty of the task: staining, tissue type, image source, and image size. The fluorescence and H&E images differ in their intensity distributions and visual structure, and cell appearance changes further with the staining method and the tissue type. Many images contain densely packed or touching cells, which are hard to separate into individual instances. Others show large variation in cell size, shape, and staining intensity. Together, these differences amount to real domain shifts between the six datasets and tests whether a model holds its performance across heterogeneous microscopy data.
blocks.zh: 我们选择CellBinDB有三个原因。 首先,它跨越了单个资源内连续被注释的几个显微镜域,因此同一评价协议对每个模型和每个域都适用不变. 第二,经评估的检查站都没有接受过关于CellBinDB的培训,这使得它成为进行零镜头评价和针对具体目标的调整的独立测试。 第三,它沿着驱动任务难度的轴来变化:污渍,组织类型,图像来源,和图像大小. 荧光和H&E图像在强度分布和视觉结构上各有不同,而细胞外观随着污渍方法和组织类型而有更进一步的变化. 许多图像中含有被密集包装或触摸的细胞,这些细胞很难被分割成单个实例. 另一些则显示出细胞大小、形状和污渍强度的巨大差异。 这些差异加在一起,就等于在六个数据集和测试一个模型是否在各种显微镜数据中保持其性能之间发生了真正的域位变化。

blocks.en: 2.2 Model zoo
blocks.zh: 2.2 动物园模型

blocks.en: The model zoo was designed to represent the principal methodological choices currently encountered in cell and nuclear instance segmentation. The benchmark includes 19 pretrained models from 11 model families, spanning task-specific convolutional networks, transformer-based segmentation models, and adaptations of general-purpose vision foundation models. These models differ in their encoder architecture and scale, instance-reconstruction strategy, separation of touching objects, pretraining domain, and suitability for different microscopy modalities. Their evaluation across the six datasets was therefore determined by the modality and domain of the data on which the corresponding models were originally trained. Models developed specifically for fluorescence microscopy were evaluated on the fluorescence datasets, models developed for histopathology were evaluated on the H&E datasets, and models with pretraining that supports both modalities were evaluated across all six CellBinDB datasets. This separation avoids evaluating models outside their intended input domain, where differences in performance could reflect unsupported modality shifts rather than the segmentation capability of the model itself. At the same time, it preserves the practical model-selection setting in which users choose models according to the imaging modality and training domain for which they were developed. As shown in Figure 2 , their total parameter counts range from 1.4 million to approximately 700 million, covering more than two orders of magnitude in model size. The patterned bars additionally indicate whether each model was evaluated on the fluorescence datasets only, the H&E datasets only, or all the six datasets.
blocks.zh: 该模型动物园旨在代表目前在细胞和核子分化中遇到的主要方法选择。 基准包括来自11个模范家庭的19个预先训练过的模型,涵盖特定任务分解网络,以变压器为基础的分解模型,以及通用视觉基础模型的改造. 这些模型在编码器架构和尺度,实例重建策略,触摸对象的分离,预训域,以及不同显微镜复制模式的适宜性等方面都有所不同. 因此,对六个数据集的评价由最初培训相应模型的数据模式和领域决定。 在荧光数据集上评价了专门为荧光显微镜开发的模型,在H&E数据集上评价了为组织病理学开发的模型,在所有六个CellBinDB数据集中评价了支持这两种模式的预训模型。 这种分离避免了在预定输入域外评价模型,其中性能的差异可以反映无支持模式的转变,而不是模型本身的分化能力. 同时,它保留了实用的模型选择设置,用户根据所开发的成像模式和培训领域选择模型. 如图2所示,它们的参数总数从140万到约7亿不等,涵盖模型大小的两个以上数量级。 图案条还进一步说明每个模型是否只在荧光数据集、H&E数据集或所有六个数据集上得到评价。

blocks.en: A central distinction among the evaluated models is how they convert pixel-level predictions into separate object instances. StarDist [ 3 ] imposes an explicit geometric prior by representing each object as a star-convex polygon described by radial distances from a candidate centre. Cellpose [ 4 ] on the other hand predicts spatial flows that guide pixels towards their corresponding object centres. Cellpose-SAM [ 17 ] follows this same decoding and post-processing pipeline; however, it uses a vision transformer encoder. MEDIAR [ 18 ] also uses a similar flow-based formulation, while combining it with a hierarchical transformer encoder and a multiscale decoder developed for heterogeneous microscopy images. HoVer-Net [ 5 ] predicts nuclear foreground together with horizontal and vertical displacement maps, which are used to separate touching nuclei in histopathology images. Mesmer [ 19 ] and DeepCell [ 20 ] use multiscale convolutional segmentation networks and distance-based post-processing. InstanSeg [ 21 ] instead learns object-centred pixel representations from which individual instances are recovered. CellSAM [ 22 ] follows a different design: its CellFinder object detector first localizes cells and generates bounding-box prompts, after which the Segment Anything model (SAM) [ 8 ] produces the corresponding masks. These approaches address the same instance separation problem through different inductive biases. CellViT-256 and CellViT-SAM-H [ 7 ] share the same general histopathology segmentation framework but use markedly different encoders: CellViT-256 employs a comparatively compact DINO-pretrained vision transformer, whereas CellViT-SAM-H uses the substantially larger ViT-H encoder initialized from SAM. Micro-SAM [ 9 ] and PathoSAM [ 23 ] adapt SAM directly to biomedical image domains through finetuning. The three Micro-SAM configurations use light-microscopy-adapted ViT-T, ViT-B, and ViT-L encoders with an automatic instance-segmentation decoder. The three PathoSAM configurations use ViT-B, ViT-L, and ViT-H encoders adapted specifically for histopathology. Within each family, varying the encoder while retaining a common application domain and segmentation formulation creates a controlled model-scale comparison. A comparison of all these models therefore helps to determine whether computationally more elaborate encoders provide greater practical value than carefully designed object representations and post-processing procedures.
blocks.zh: 被评价模型的一个中心区别是它们如何将像素水平的预测转换成单独的对象实例. StarDist [3] 将每个物体表示为用从候选中心射线相距描述的恒星-圆锥多边形,从而将一个明显的几何排列在前面. 而Cellpose [4]则预测了引导像素到相应对象中心的空间流. Cellpose-SAM [17] 遵循这个相同的解码和后处理管道;然而,它使用一个视觉变形器编码器. MEDIAR [18] 也使用相类似的以流为主的配体,同时将其与分级变压器编码器和为多相异微镜图像所开发的多相分级解码器相结合. HoVer-Net [5] 预测核前地与水平和垂直相位图,它们用于将触觉核分出在组织病理学图像中. Mesmer [19]和DeepCell [20] 使用多尺度分化网络和远程后处理. InstanSeg [21] 转而学习以对象为中心的像素表达式,从中恢复单个实例. CellSAM [22]遵循了不同的设计:其CellFinder对象探测器首先将细胞定位并生成边框-box提示,之后分块Anything模型(SAM)[8]产生相应的口罩. 这些办法通过不同的诱导偏差来解决同一情况分离问题。 CellViT-256和CellViT-SAM-H [7] 具有相同的一般组织病理分解框架,但使用截然不同的编码器:CellViT-256使用相对紧凑的DINO预加固视变压器,而CellViT-SAM-H使用从SAM初始化的显著更大的ViT-H编码器. Micro-SAM [9]和PathoSAM [23]通过微调直接将SAM与生物医学图像域相适应. 3个微分SAM配置采用轻微分解的VIT-T,VIT-B,和VIT-L编码器,并带有自动实例分解解码器. 3个PathoSAM配置使用ViT-B,ViT-L,和专门为组织病理学而改编的ViT-H编码器. 在每个家族内部,改变编码器,同时保留一个共同的应用域和分解配方,形成一个受控的模型尺度比较. 因此,对所有这些模型进行比较有助于确定,在计算上更为详细的编码器是否比精心设计的物体表示和后处理程序提供更大的实际价值。

blocks.en: Comparing these models is important because a larger foundation-model encoder may increase representational capacity, but also increases parameter storage, inference energy, memory requirements, and fine-tuning cost. Overall, the model zoo provide structured variation along four dimensions: instance-reconstruction strategy, encoder architecture and scale, modality specialization, and adaptation regime. The inclusion of related variants within Cellpose, CellViT, Micro-SAM, and PathoSAM permits relatively controlled within-family comparisons, whereas the broader set supports comparisons across fundamentally different formulations.
blocks.zh: 比较这些模型很重要,因为一个更大的地基模型编码器可能会增加代表能力,但也会增加参数存储,推论能,内存要求,以及微调成本. 总的来说,模型动物园在四个方面提供了结构上的差异:实例重建战略、编码器结构和规模、模式专业化和适应制度。 将相关变体纳入Cellpose、CellViT、Micro-SAM和PathoSAM可以相对控制家庭内部的比较,而更广泛的一套则支持对根本不同的配方进行比较。

blocks.en: 2.3 Segmentation performance evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.3 分部业绩评价

blocks.en: We evaluate segmentation performance using the Aggregated Jaccard Index plus (AJI + ) [ 5 ] , Panoptic Quality (PQ) [ 24 ] , and Normalized Surface Dice (NSD) [ 25 ] metrics, which capture complementary aspects of segmentation quality. AJI + measures instance-level overlap while accounting for unmatched reference and predicted objects. PQ jointly evaluates instance recognition and the segmentation quality of correctly matched objects. NSD measures agreement between the predicted and reference boundaries within a specified spatial tolerance. All three metrics range from zero to one, with higher values indicating better segmentation quality.

2.4 Energy measurements
blocks.zh: 2.4 能源测量

blocks.en: We measure energy consumption separately for each inference and fine-tuning phase using hardware-level energy counters exposed through the operating system and GPU management interface. Direct wall-socket measurement with an external power meter was not used because the experiments were conducted on a shared data-center compute cluster rather than on a dedicated workstation with an accessible, isolated power connection. In such an environment, an external meter installed at the rack, power-distribution unit, or server power input would measure the aggregate electrical consumption of the corresponding infrastructure and would not directly isolate the energy attributable to the selected GPU and processor domains. Obtaining component-level measurements with external instrumentation would additionally require physical access to the server power-delivery path and coordination with the data-center infrastructure, which was outside the scope of available experimental setup. This is why, we used software accessible hardware counters to provide a practical and reproducible means of obtaining component-level measurements without modifying the cluster infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 我们利用通过操作系统和GPU管理接口暴露的硬件级能计,分别测量每个推论和微调相的能耗. 由于实验是在一个共享数据中心计算集群上进行的,而不是在具有无障碍、孤立的电源连接的专用工作站上进行的,因此没有使用用外部电量表进行直接墙口测量。 在这种环境中,安装在机架、放电装置或服务器电源输入器上的外部电量表将测量相应基础设施的电消耗总量,不会直接隔离可归属于选定的GPU和处理器域的能耗。 利用外部仪器获得组件级测量,还需要实际进入服务器的电源传送路径,并与数据中心基础设施相协调,因为数据中心不在现有的实验设置范围之内。 因此,我们使用软件无障碍硬件计数器提供了一种实用而可复制的手段,在不修改集群基础设施的情况下获得组件级的测量.

blocks.en: GPU energy measurement was obtained using the NVIDIA Management Library (NVML), accessed through the nvidia-ml-py Python bindings [ 28 , 29 ] . NVML is the NVIDIA-supported programmatic interface underlying nvidia-smi and provides access to GPU power measurements for supported data-center GPUs, including the Tesla V100 used in this study [ 29 ] . The use of NVML is also established in empirical studies of energy consumption on NVIDIA GPUs [ 30 , 31 ] . Processor-package and DRAM energy were obtained from Intel Running Average Power Limit (RAPL) energy counters exposed through the Linux powercap interface [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] . RAPL has been extensively evaluated against external power measurements and has been reported to exhibit strong correlation with plug-level power consumption while introducing negligible measurement overhead, making it suitable for energy monitoring on servers and computing clusters [ 33 ] . These interfaces measure energy at the hardware-domain level and thus do not include power consumed by the power supply, cooling system, storage devices, networking equipment, or other infrastructure outside the monitored GPU, CPU-package, and DRAM domains.
blocks.zh: GPU能量测量是使用NVIDIA管理库(NVML)获得的,通过nvidia-ml-py Python绑定[28,29]访问. NVML是nvidia-smi所支持的由NVIDIA支持的程序接口,为所支持的数据-中心GPU提供GPU功率测量,包括本研究中使用的Tesla V100[29]. 在NVIDIA GPU的能耗经验研究中也确立了NVML的使用. [30,31]. 通过Linux powercap接口曝光的Intel Running Everyer Power Limit(RAPL)能量计数器获得了处理器-包和DRAM能量[32,33,34]. 对照外部电能测量,对RAPL进行了广泛评价,据报告,它与插头电能消耗有很强的相关性,同时采用了可忽略不计的测量间接费用,使其适合对服务器和计算集群进行能能监测[33]. 这些接口在硬件领域水平上测量能量,因此不包括被监测的GPU,CPU-package,和DRAM域外的供电所消耗的能耗.

blocks.en: The compute node was allocated exclusively to the experiments, and each experiment used one selected GPU without competing GPU processes. The complete energy increment recorded for the selected GPU, CPU packages, and DRAM domains during each measurement interval was attributed to the benchmark workload. This experimental isolation reduces interference from concurrent computational workloads and makes the component-level measurements comparable across models. The same hardware, measurement interfaces, measurement procedure, and measurement scope were used for all evaluated models, which is particularly important for the relative comparison of energy consumption.
blocks.zh: 计算节点被专门分配给了实验,每个实验都使用一个选定的GPU,而没有竞争的GPU过程. 在每个测量间隔期间,选定的GPU、CPU软件包和DRAM域的全部能量递增记录都归因于基准工作量。 这种实验性隔离减少了同时进行的计算工作量的干扰,使各模型的组件级测量具有可比性. 所有被评价的模型都采用了相同的硬件、测量接口、测量程序和测量范围,这对于能源消耗的相对比较特别重要。

blocks.en: The measurement interval encompassed the complete inference or fine-tuning phase executed by the experiment. For inference, this included network instantiation, checkpoint loading, transfer to the GPU, CUDA initialization, model-specific normalization, augmentations, channel adaptation, resizing, rescaling, tiling, forward propagation, transfer of outputs to the CPU, and model-specific instance reconstruction and post-processing. For fine-tuning, the measured interval additionally included loss calculation, backpropagation, parameter updates, and all training epochs. Thus, model-specific computational operations such as Cellpose flow integration, StarDist non-maximum suppression, and SAM-based mask generation were included in the measured energy. Dataset-level transformations performed before model invocation, logging, and metric calculations were excluded because they were not part of the model execution pipeline being evaluated. GPU operations were synchronized immediately before the initial and final counter readings to ensure that asynchronously queued GPU operations were completed before the corresponding energy values were recorded.
blocks.zh: 测量间隔包括试验进行的完整推论或微调阶段。 就推论而言,这包括网络即时化、检查站加载、转至GPU、CUDA初始化、模式特有正常化、增强、信道调整、再大小化、再规模化、平板化、前向传播、向CPU转移产出、模式特有实例重建和后处理。 对于微调,所测量的间隔还包含损失计算、回推、参数更新以及所有训练时段。 因此,Cellpose流量集成,StarDist非最大压制,以SAM为主的口罩生成等模型特有计算操作被包括在被测量的能量中. 在模型引用、记录和计量计算之前进行的数据集级转换被排除在外,因为它们不是正在评价的模型执行程序的一部分。 GPU操作在初始和最终的对数读取前立即同步,以确保同步排队的GPU操作在记录相应的能量值之前完成.

blocks.en: Because NVML and RAPL report hardware-domain energy rather than wall-socket electricity, their measurements are not assumed to be exact substitutes for external power-meter measurements. Previous validation studies have shown that the agreement between on-chip energy sensors and external meters depends on the hardware architecture and workload, particularly for GPU measurements [ 31 ] . The present study therefore emphasizes consistency of the measurement procedure and controlled comparison across models rather than interpreting the reported values as exact facility-level electricity consumption.
blocks.zh: 由于NVML和RAPL报告硬件域能而不是墙口电能,因此他们的测量不被认为是外部电量计测量的精确替代品. 以往的验证研究表明,芯片能感应器和外表之间的协议取决于硬件结构和工作量,特别是GPU测量[31]. 因此,本研究报告强调测量程序和不同模型的控制比较的一致性,而不是将所报告的数值解释为精确的设施一级电力消耗。

blocks.en: 2.4.1 GPU energy
blocks.zh: 2.4.1 GPU 能量

blocks.en: GPU energy was measured using the cumulative device-energy counter provided by NVML. After synchronizing the selected GPU, the counter was read at the start of each measured inference or fine-tuning phase. The GPU was synchronized again after the phase to ensure that all queued operations had completed before the counter was read a second time.
blocks.zh: GPU能用由NVML提供的累积器能计数器来测量. 在同步所选的GPU后,每个被测量到的推论或微调相的开始会读取计数器. 阶段后GPU再次同步,以确保所有排队操作在计数器第二次被读取前完成.

blocks.en: Let G start G_{\mathrm{start}} and G end G_{\mathrm{end}} denote the counter readings at the start and end boundaries, respectively. Both values represent the cumulative energy consumed by the GPU since the NVIDIA driver was loaded and are reported by NVML in millijoules (mJ). They do not represent instantaneous GPU power. The GPU energy consumed during the measured phase is calculated as: E GPU = G end − G start E_{\mathrm{GPU}}=G_{\mathrm{end}}-G_{\mathrm{start}} (6) where E GPU E_{\mathrm{GPU}} is expressed in millijoules (mJ). Although the counter is cumulative, subtracting the start reading from the end reading isolates the energy consumed between the two measurement boundaries.
blocks.zh: 让 G start G_{\mathrm{ start} 和 G end G_{\mathrm{end} 分别表示起始和结尾边界的对数读取 。 这两个值都代表了自NVIDIA驱动程序被上载以来GPU所消耗的累计能量,并由NVML以毫焦耳(mJ)来报告. 它们并不代表瞬间GPU的力量. 在所测量的相相中消耗的GPU能被计算为: E GPU = G端- G起步 E_{\mathrm{GPU}}=G_{\mathrm{end}}-G_{\mathrm{start}}} (6) EGPU E_{\mathrm{GPU}}以毫焦耳(mJ)表示. 虽然计数器是相累积的,但从收尾读取起的读取,将所消耗的能量隔离出两个测量边界之间.

blocks.en: This device-level measurement represents the energy recorded for the complete selected GPU rather than for an individual process. Because the selected GPU was used exclusively by our experiment, the complete counter increment was assigned to the evaluated workload.
blocks.zh: 这种设备级的测量代表了完整所选GPU所记录的能量,而不是单个过程所记录的能量. 由于所选的GPU完全用于我们的实验,因此完全反增量被分配到评估的工作量.

blocks.en: 2.5 Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI)
blocks.zh: 2.5 可持续性-了解性能指数

NetScore [ 35 ] was introduced to quantify the balance between accuracy, architectural complexity, and computational complexity. NetScore represented an important step towards resource-aware model comparison, but its computational term is an analytical operation count only. MAC count does not capture hardware efficiency, memory access, data movement, software implementation, or other system-level effects that can cause models with similar operation counts to consume different amounts of energy.

blocks.en: The authors in the paper [ 36 ] subsequently proposed the Sustainable-Accuracy Metric (SAM) to combine predictive accuracy with electricity consumption. SAM is defined as: SAM = β ​ a α log 10 ⁡ ( E ) \mathrm{SAM}=\beta\frac{a^{\alpha}}{\log_{10}\left(E\right)} (13) where a a is accuracy and E E is electricity consumption in kilowatt-hours. This formulation replaces an analytical computational proxy with electricity consumption. Here, β \beta is only a global scaling constant; it changes the numerical range of SAM but cannot change the weight of accuracy or energy. Also, SAM contains no independent representation of model scale, meaning that two models with similar accuracy and measured energy receive similar scores even when their storage and memory requirements differ substantially.
blocks.zh: 论文[36]中的作者随后提出了"可持续准确度量衡"(SAM),将预测准确度与用电量相结合. SAM被定义为: SAM = β a α log 10 ⁡ (E )\mathrm{ sAM}=\beta\ frac{a^{\alpha}}{\-log_{-10}\-left (E\right)} (13) 其中的精度为精度,E为用千瓦时的用电量. 这种配方用电力消耗取代了分析计算代用. 在这里,β\β只是一个全球缩放常数;它改变SAM的数值范围,但不能改变精度或能的权重. 另外,SAM没有独立地代表模型尺度,这意味着两个精度相近并被测量能的模型即使存储和内存要求相差很大,也会得到相近的分数.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose a novel metric, Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI). It combines predictive performance, energy consumption during inference and fine-tuning, and model parameter count through a weighted multiplicative formulation: SAPI = P α [ log 10 ⁡ ( E ) ] β ⋅ [ log 10 ⁡ ( N θ ) ] γ \mathrm{SAPI}=\frac{P^{\alpha}}{\left[\log_{10}\left(E\right)\right]^{\beta}\cdot\left[\log_{10}\left(N_{\theta}\right)\right]^{\gamma}} (14) where P P is the segmentation performance as defined in Equation 5 ; E E is the energy consumed by the model, and N θ N_{\theta} is the total number of parameters in the model.

blocks.en: The base-10 logarithm is applied to E E and N θ N_{\theta} because both quantities vary over several orders of magnitude across model architectures, whereas the performance score ( P P ) is bounded between zero and one. Using the unscaled energy and parameter values would allow their substantially larger numerical ranges to dominate the overall SAPI score and would impose a penalty that increases directly with absolute scale. The logarithmic transformation compresses these ranges while preserving their ordering, so that a model with greater energy consumption or more parameters always receives a larger penalty. It also introduces diminishing marginal penalties: an equal multiplicative increase in energy or parameter count produces an equal increment on the logarithmic scale, irrespective of the initial magnitude. Base 10 is used because it provides a direct interpretation in terms of orders of magnitude; for example, a tenfold increase in either quantity increases its logarithm by one. Under these fixed conventions, the logarithmic terms provide interpretable and comparable penalties for operational energy demand and model scale without allowing either component to overwhelm the performance term.
blocks.zh: 基础-10对数适用于E和N-Q-N-Thetha}因为两个数量在模型结构的几个数量级上有所不同,而性能分数(PP)则被限定在0到1之间。 使用未标定的能量和参数值,可以使其数值范围大得多,在SAPI总得分中占据主导地位,并会施加随绝对尺度而直接增加的惩罚. 对数转换在保持其顺序的同时会压缩这些范围,这样能量消耗或参数较多的模型总能得到更大的惩罚. 它还引入了递减边际处罚:能量或参数计数的等倍增产生对数尺度的等相递增,而不论初始幅度. 使用第10个基数是因为它提供按数量级的直接解释;例如,两个数量增加十倍,其对数就增加一倍。 根据这些固定的公约,对数术语对业务能源需求和模型尺度规定了可解释和可比较的处罚,但不允许其中任一部件超过业绩术语。

blocks.en: The exponents α \alpha , β \beta , and γ \gamma are positive weights satisfying the constraint: α + β + γ = 1 \alpha+\beta+\gamma=1 (15)
blocks.zh: 代表α-α、β-β和γ-γ的正分量 限制: α + β + γ = 1\alpha+\beta+\gamma = 1 (15)

blocks.en: The exponents α \alpha , β \beta and γ \gamma control the relative influence of performance, energy consumption, and model complexity, respectively. Requiring α , β , γ > 0 \alpha,\beta,\gamma>0 preserves the intended monotonic behaviour of the index: higher performance must increase SAPI, whereas higher energy consumption or a larger parameter count must decrease it. A zero exponent would remove the corresponding dimension from the index, while a negative exponent would reverse its meaning by rewarding lower performance or greater resource use. The constraint ( α + β + γ = 1 \alpha+\beta+\gamma=1 ) is imposed to normalize the exponents into a common weighting scale. Without this constraint, multiplying all three exponents by the same positive constant would change the numerical magnitude and dispersion of SAPI without changing the relative weighting among its components or the resulting model ordering, because the transformed score would simply be a positive power of the original score. Enforcing a unit sum therefore removes this arbitrary degree of freedom and makes each weighting configuration uniquely defined and directly comparable with alternative configurations. It also permits relative priorities, such as (3:2:1), to be represented unambiguously as ( α \alpha =1/2), ( β \beta =1/3), and ( γ \gamma =1/6).

blocks.en: 2.6 Experimental Study Design
blocks.zh: 2.6 实验研究设计

blocks.en: We evaluated the models under three experimental conditions: zero-shot inference, few-shot full-model fine-tuning, and few-shot fine-tuning with a frozen encoder. Because CellBinDB does not provide predefined training, validation, and test partitions, we defined the support and test sets for the few-shot experiments as described below. The same evaluation protocol was used for all applicable model-dataset combinations.
blocks.zh: 我们在三个实验条件下对模型进行了评价:零发推论,几发全模型微调,用冷冻编码器微调. 因为手机 DB不提供预定义的训练,验证,和测试分区,我们定义了以下描述的几发实验的支持和测试集. 对所有适用的模型-数据集组合采用了同样的评价协议。

blocks.en: 2.6.1 Zero-shot Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.6.1 零镜头评价

blocks.en: All 19 model configurations were evaluated in the zero-shot setting. Each model was applied to all the images in all the datasets supported by its respective pretrained checkpoint. No image was used to update model parameters, select inference thresholds, or modify model-specific post-processing settings. Predictions were generated using the native inference pipeline of each implementation. No manually supplied point, box, or mask prompts were used. Models that support prompt-based inference were instead evaluated using their automatic instance-segmentation procedures. Model-specific automatic settings, such as automatic diameter estimation in Cellpose, were retained where applicable. This experimental setting allowed us to assess how the models perform on the CellBinDB datasets out of the box, without any dataset-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 全部19个型号配置在"零发"设定中得到了评价. 每个模型被应用到由各自经过预先训练的检查站支持的所有数据集中的所有图像上. 没有使用图像来更新模型参数,选择推论阈值,或修改模型特定的后处理设置. 利用每次执行的原生推论管道作出预测。 没有使用手动提供的点、框或口罩提示。 支持即时推论的模型则使用其自动实例分类程序加以评价。 酌情保留特定型号的自动设置,如Cellpose的自动直径估计。 这种实验设置使我们能够评估模型在CellBinDB的数据集上如何在框外运行,而无需对数据集进行特定的修改.

blocks.en: 2.6.2 Few-shot Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.6.2 少发子弹的适应

blocks.en: Pretrained segmentation models can be adapted to a target microscopy domain using a small number of labeled images [ 40 , 9 , 41 ] . However, the effectiveness of few-shot adaptation can depend on the images selected for fine-tuning [ 11 ] . This is particularly relevant for microscopy instance segmentation, where producing accurate object-level annotations is laborious and time-consuming [ 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 预受训练分化模型可以被改造为目标显微镜域,使用少量被标记的图像[40,9,41]. 然而,几发改编的效果可以取决于选取来微调的图像[11]. 这与显微镜实例分解特别相关,在显微镜中,制作准确的物体级说明是费时费力的[42].

blocks.en: For few-shot fine-tuning, we used the following procedure for selecting the support set and test set. For each dataset, we randomly selected one image, using a predefined seed, from a tissue group within the dataset as a support image. The total number of support images therefore equals to the number of tissues present in the dataset, as reported in Table 1 . All the remaining images in the dataset formed the test set. For a given dataset and seed, the same support and test sets was used for every compatible model.
blocks.zh: 对于几发微调,我们使用以下程序来选择辅助集和测试集. 对于每个数据集,我们用预先定义的种子,从数据集内的组织组中随机选择一个图像作为支持图像. 因此,如表1所报告,支持图像总数等于数据集所显示的组织数目。 数据集中所有剩余图像组成了测试集. 对于给定的数据集和种子,每个相容模型都使用同样的支持和测试集.

blocks.en: We did not create a separate validation set because splitting the already small support set would further reduce the number of labeled images available for adaptation. An exploratory analysis of training-loss behavior was used to select a common training duration of 100 epochs. All fine-tuning experiments were therefore run for 100 epochs, and the model obtained after the final epoch was used for evaluation. Model-specific default training hyperparameters were retained with a batch size of 8 used for all models.
blocks.zh: 我们没有创建单独的验证集,因为拆分已经很小的支持集将进一步减少可供修改的标签图像数量. 对培训损失行为进行了探索性分析,以选择100个世纪的共同培训期限。 因此,所有微调实验都为100个纪元运行,最终纪元后获得的模型被用于评价. 保留了特定模型的默认训练超参数,所有模型的分批尺寸为8个。

blocks.en: Models can be fine-tuned either by updating all parameters (full-model regime) or by keeping the encoder weights frozen while updating only the remaining trainable components (frozen-encoder regime). In the full-model regime, all model parameters were trainable from the first epoch. In the frozen-encoder regime, the encoder or backbone parameters were held fixed, while the model-specific decoder, prediction heads, and other designated adaptation components remained trainable. The relative effectiveness of these strategies depends on the architecture, the size of the support set, and the degree of domain shift between the pretraining data and the target dataset. Freezing the encoder can preserve transferable pretrained representations and reduce the number of trainable parameters, but it may also restrict the model’s ability to adapt its feature representation to the target domain. Previous studies have therefore reported differing outcomes for frozen-encoder and full-model adaptation [ 43 , 44 ] . We evaluate both possibilities under comparable conditions. We train and evaluate each fine-tunable model in both regimes using exactly the same support set and test test.
blocks.zh: 模型可以通过更新所有参数(完整模型制度)来进行微调,也可以通过保持编码器的重量被冻结,而仅更新所剩可被训练部件(frozen-encoder制度)来进行微调. 在全模型制度下,所有模型参数都是从第一个时代开始可以被训练的. 在被冻结的编码器制度下,编码器或主干参数被固定,而模型专用的解码器,预测头等指定的适应组件仍然可以被训练. 这些策略的相对有效性取决于架构,支持集的大小,以及预训数据与目标数据集之间的域转移程度. 冻结编码器可以保留可转移的被预先训练的表示并减少可训练参数的数量,但也可能限制模型将其特征表示器调整到目标域的能力. 因此,以往的研究表明,冷冻编码器和整型改造的结果不同[43、44]。 我们评价两种可能性,条件相似。 我们使用完全相同的辅助装置和测试测试,在两种制度中训练和评价每个精细可触的模型。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning was performed for 16 of the 19 model configurations. DeepCell NuclearSegmentation, Mesmer, and CellSAM were evaluated only in the zero-shot setting because their fine-tuning interfaces were not available to us. Information on the exact model checkpoint names and software versions are provided in the Supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 19个型号配置中的16个进行了精细调整. DeepCell NuclearSegment, Mesmer,和CellSAM只在零发设定中被评价,因为他们的微调界面对我们来说不可用. 补充材料提供了有关检查站确切的模型名称和软件版本的资料。

blocks.en: 2.6.3 Repeated Experiments
blocks.zh: 2.6.3 重复试验

blocks.en: Each experiment was repeated ten times using seeds 0 to 9. For each seed, a tissue-stratified support set was sampled independently. Repeating the experiments across these support sets reduced dependence on a single support-set selection. For a given dataset and seed, the support set and test was kept the same across all the models and both fine-tuning regimes.
blocks.zh: 每个实验都用0到9个种子重复了10次. 对每个种子都独立抽取了一组组织分级支持。 在这些支持中重复实验,减少了对单一支持设置选择的依赖。 对于给定的数据集和种子,在所有模型和微调系统中,支持集和测试都保持不变。

blocks.en: The seeds were propagated to Python, NumPy, PyTorch, and TensorFlow where applicable. Deterministic cuDNN execution was enabled and cuDNN benchmarking was disabled. These settings reduced uncontrolled variation from sampling, data ordering, augmentation, model initialization where applicable, and stochastic framework operations, although complete bitwise determinism cannot be guaranteed for every third-party implementation.
blocks.zh: 种子在适用的情况下被推广到Python,NumPy,PyTorch和TensorFlow. 已启用决定性的 cuDNN 执行, 并禁用 cuDNN 基准 。 这些设置降低了抽样、数据订购、增强、模型启动(如果适用)和结构化框架操作的无节制差异,尽管无法保证每个第三方的执行都具有完整的比特确定性。

blocks.en: 2.6.4 Computational Setup
blocks.zh: 2.6.4 计算设置

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on the same compute node equipped with two NVIDIA Tesla V100 PCIe GPUs with 32 GB memory each, two Intel Xeon Gold 6226R processors at 2.90 GHz with 16 physical cores per processor, and 501 GiB of system memory. Only GPU 0 was used for the experiments, and no other GPU processes were running on the node.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都在同一个计算节点上进行,配备了两台NVIDIA Tesla V100PCIe GPU,每台有32GB内存,两台Intel Xeon Gold 6226R处理器在2.90GHz,每个处理器有16个物理核心,以及501 GiB的系统内存. 只有GPU 0用于实验,没有其他GPU进程运行在节点上.

blocks.en: To reduce the effect of the GPU’s thermal state on the energy measurements, the GPU was allowed to cool to 45 ∘ C before each measurement. The same cooldown procedure was applied before each experiment. Energy consumption was then measured during the execution of the corresponding inference or fine-tuning workload using the procedure described in Section 2.4 .
blocks.zh: 为了降低GPU的热能状态对能量测量的影响,GPU被允许在每次测量前将GPU冷却到45 QC. 每次试验前都采用了同样的冷却程序。 然后,利用第2.4节所描述的程序,在进行相应的推断或微调工作量时衡量能耗。

blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: All primary sustainability-aware comparisons were conducted using the predefined SAPI weights α \alpha =1/2, β \beta =1/3, and γ \gamma =1/6, corresponding to a performance–-energy–-size weighting ratio of (3:2:1). This weighting gives segmentation performance the greatest influence because predictive accuracy remains the primary requirement for model utility, while assigning substantial importance to energy consumption and a smaller, but non-negligible, contribution to model size. The combined energy term was calculated using λ \lambda =0.8, so that fine-tuning energy consumption contributed 20% and post fine-tuning inference energy consumption contributed 80%. This choice represents a deployment-oriented setting in which inference is expected to be performed repeatedly after adaptation, while still accounting for the computational cost incurred during fine-tuning. Unless otherwise stated, all SAPI rankings reported below use these fixed values.

blocks.en: 3.1 Zero-shot inference
blocks.zh: 3.1 零发推论

blocks.en: We performed zero-shot inference to compare the models without any adaptation to the CellBinDB datasets. The results showed clear differences in segmentation performance, inference energy consumption, and sustainability-aware utility across models and datasets. Performance also depended strongly on the dataset, and the models with the highest segmentation scores did not always achieve the highest SAPI ZS \mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{ZS}} values. We therefore present the results in four parts: predictive performance, inference energy consumption, the joint relationship between performance, energy use, and model size, and the resulting SAPI ZS \mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{ZS}} rankings. In the supplementary material we provide qualitative comparisons of the predicted masks produced by every compatible model for one sample image from each dataset, together with the corresponding input image and ground-truth mask.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了零镜头推论,以比较模型,而不对CellBinDB数据集作任何修改. 结果显示,各模型和数据集在分解性能、推断能耗和对可持续性认识的效用方面存在明显差异。 性能也强烈地依赖于数据集,分数分数最高的模型并不总是能实现最高的SAPI ZS\mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{ZS}}. 因此,我们将结果分为四个部分:预测性能、推断能耗、性能、能耗和模型大小之间的联合关系,以及由此产生的SAPI ZS\mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{ZS}}排名。 在补充材料中,我们提供了每个兼容模型为每个数据集一个样本图像产生的预测口罩的质量比较,以及相应的输入口罩和地-真实口罩。

blocks.en: We compared mean zero-shot performance with inference energy and model size in Figure 5 . In contrast, parameter count showed a strong positive association with inference energy ( ρ = 0.747 \rho=0.747 ). blocks.en: Several relatively small and energy-efficient models achieved competitive performance. In comparison, CellposeSAM consumed 410.91 J per image but achieved a lower mean performance of 0.616 over the same datasets. CellSAM and HoVer-Net also had high energy requirements without reaching the highest performance levels. These results show that high inference energy consumption did not necessarily translate into better zero-shot segmentation.

blocks.en: Among the models evaluated on the two H&E datasets, the PathoSAM variants and the two CellViT configurations achieved the highest mean performance. blocks.en: 3.2 Few-shot Adaptation
blocks.zh: 3.2 几发

blocks.en: For each dataset, we randomly selected one image from every tissue group to form the support set and used all the remaining images as the test set. We fine-tuned the model on the support set using two strategies i.e. full-model fine-tuning and frozen-encoder fine-tuning. In full-model fine-tuning, we updated all model parameters. In frozen-encoder fine-tuning, we kept the encoder weights fixed and updated the remaining trainable parameters. We evaluated the zero-shot checkpoint and both fine-tuned variants on the same test set. We repeated the complete support-set selection, fine-tuning, and evaluation procedure with ten different random seeds to capture variation caused by support set and test set composition.
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,我们随机从每个组织组中选取出一幅图像来组成支持集,并将所剩所有图像作为测试集. 我们用两种策略,即全模型的微调和冷冻编码器的微调,微调了支持集上的模型. 在全模型的微调中,我们更新了所有模型参数. 在冷冻-编码器的微调中,我们保持了编码器重量的固定并更新了剩余的可列车参数. 我们在同一套测试中评估了零发检查站和两个微调的变体。 我们用10个不同的随机种子重复了完整的支持设置选择、微调和评价程序,以捕捉支持设置和测试设置构成造成的变化。

blocks.en:
Few-shot adaptation improved segmentation performance for most compatible
model-dataset combinations (Figures 7 – 12 ). The largest gains generally occurred when the corresponding zero-shot model performed poorly. This pattern was particularly clear on HE, DAPI, and ssDNA, where adaptation substantially improved Cellpose, InstanSeg, Hover-Net, and MicroSAM models. By contrast, the gains were usually smaller on the two 10xGenomics datasets, where several models already achieved relatively strong zero-shot performance.
blocks.zh:
对大多数兼容性而言,少有镜头的适应性能得到改善
模型-数据集组合 (图7-12). 最大的收益一般发生在相应的零射出型号表现不佳时. 在HE、DAPI和ssDNA中,这种模式特别明显,适应方式大大改进了Cellpose、InstanSeg、Hover-Net和MicroSAM模型。 相形之下,在两个10xGenomics数据集上,收益通常较小,几个模型已经取得了相对强大的零发性能.

blocks.en:
Full-model fine-tuning generally produced stronger performance than frozen-encoder fine-tuning. Updating the encoder allowed the model to adjust its learned representation to the target images, which was especially useful for models that transferred poorly in the zero-shot setting. However,
frozen-encoder fine-tuning sometimes remained close to full-model fine-tuning and occasionally performed slightly better. For example, freezing the encoder improved the results of CellViT-256 on both the H&E datasets. InstanSeg on mIF shows a more pronounced exception, as the frozen-encoder strategy outperformed full-model fine-tuning considerably.
blocks.zh:
全模式微调一般产生的性能比冷冻-编码器微调更强. 更新编码器可以使模型调整其所学到的表达到目标图像,这对零发设定中传输不良的模型特别有用. 不过,
被冷冻的编码器微调有时仍然接近于全模微调,偶尔表现稍好. 例如,冻结编码器提高了CellViT-256在H&E数据集上的结果. instanSeg on mIF显示一个更明显的例外,因为被冻结的编码器策略大大地超过了全模型的微调.

blocks.en: The response to adaptation also differed across datasets. Performance on mIF remained lower and more variable than on the other datasets, although StarDist (Fluo) retained strong performance and several general-purpose models improved after fine-tuning. DAPI and ssDNA showed more consistent gains, particularly for Cellpose cyto2 and Cellpose cyto3. On the H&E datasets, adaptation substantially improved models with weak zero-shot transfer, including InstanSeg and the Cellpose cyto models. CellposeSAM and MEDIAR achieved strong adapted performance on several datasets, while the preferred model still depended on the image modality and dataset.
blocks.zh: 各种数据集对适应的反应也各不相同。 相对于其他数据集,MIF的性能仍然较低,更可变,不过StarDist(Fluo)保留了强性能,并经过微调后改进了多款通用模型. DAPI和ssDNA表现出更一致的增益,尤其是对于Cellpose细胞2和Cellpose细胞3而言. 在H&E数据集上,以微弱的零射电传动进行大幅改进的模型,包括InstanSeg和Cellpose细胞模型. CellposeSAM和MEDIAR在多个数据集上实现了强大的适应性能,而首选的模型仍然依赖于图像模式和数据集.

blocks.en: Adaptation did not improve every model. Cellpose cyto3 showed little benefit on mIF, while InstanSeg on 10xGenomics_DAPI and CellViT-256 on 10xGenomics_HE performed slightly worse than their zero-shot baselines. While the performance of most models is stable across the ten runs, CellposeSAM with frozen-encoder finetuning shows greater variance in performance on most datasets. Also, InstanSeg and MEDIAR have larger performance variations for the mIF dataset. These exceptions show that few-shot adaptation depends on both the target dataset and the pretrained model. They also show that updating all the parameters does not always provide the most stable or better result.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning energy E ft E_{\mathrm{ft}} varied considerably across models (Figure 13 ). The figure reports the energy consumed per support image, averaged across the datasets compatible with each model and across the repeated runs. Cellpose cyto2 and cyto3 required the least energy under both adaptation strategies. InstanSeg, MEDIAR, and StarDist also remained among the lower-energy models. In contrast, the larger MicroSAM, PathoSAM, and CellViT variants occupied the high-energy end of the comparison. PathoSAM ViT-H consumed the most energy during full-model fine-tuning.

blocks.en:
Freezing the encoder during fine-tuning reduced the training energy E ft E_{\mathrm{ft}} for all models. However, the amount of the reduction depended strongly on the model. The largest reductions appeared for CellposeSAM, CellViT-SAM-H, Hover-Net, and PathoSAM ViT-H. Freezing the encoder
also produced clear savings for the larger MicroSAM and PathoSAM variants. By contrast, the difference between the two fine-tuning strategies was small for StarDist, Cellpose, InstanSeg, MEDIAR, CellViT-256, and MicroSAM ViT-T.
blocks.zh:
在微调时冻结编码器会降低所有型号的训练能 E ft E_{\mathrm{ft}}. 然而,削减数额在很大程度上取决于模式。 削减最多的是CellposeSAM、CellViT-SAM-H、Hover-Net和PathoSAM Vit-H。 冻结编码器
还为较大的MicroSAM和PathoSAM变体产生了明显的节省. 相形之下,StarDist,Cellpose,InstanSeg,MEDIAR,CellViT-256,和MicroSAM Vit-T的两种微调策略差别很小.

blocks.en: Across all the models, GPU and CPU activity accounted for the largest shares of fine-tuning energy ( E ft E_{\mathrm{ft}} ), while RAM contributed relatively little. Larger models generally consumed more fine-tuning energy, but model size alone did not explain the observed differences. Models with similar parameter counts sometimes showed distinct energy profiles, and encoder freezing produced different levels of savings across architectures. Fine-tuning energy therefore reflected both model scale and the computational structure of the adaptation process.
blocks.zh: 在所有模型中,GPU和CPU活动占微调能的最大份额(Eft E_{\mathrm{ft}}),而RAM贡献相对较少. 更大型的模型一般消耗更精细的能量,但单是模型尺寸并不能解释观察到的差异. 具有相近参数计数的模型有时显示出不同的能谱,而编码器被冻结在各种架构中产生了不同的节能水平. 因此,微调能量既反映了模型规模,也反映了适应进程的计算结构。
