blocks.en: The SAPI FT + I \mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{FT+I}} results show clear differences across models and datasets (Figure 14 ). Smaller models that combined strong adapted performance with low fine-tuning and inference energy generally received the highest scores. As a result, the sustainability-aware ranking did not always follow the performance ranking. Several large models achieved competitive segmentation performance after adaptation, but their higher energy consumption and parameter counts reduced their SAPI FT + I \mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{FT+I}} scores.
blocks.zh: SAPI FT + I \ mathrm{ SAPI + mathrm{ FT+I} 结果显示了不同模型和数据集之间的明显差异(图14). 将强适应性能与低微调和推论能相结合的更小的模型普遍得到最高分. 因此,了解可持续性的排名并不总是遵循业绩排名。 一些大型模型在适应后实现了竞争性分化性能,但其较高的能耗和参数计数降低了其SAPI FT + I\mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{FT+I}}分数.

blocks.en: Across the fluorescence datasets, InstanSeg achieved the highest average SAPI FT + I \mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{FT+I}} . Cellpose cyto2, Cellpose cyto3, and MEDIAR followed closely. StarDist (Fluo) also remained competitive. The heatmap shows that these rankings were not consistent across all fluorescence datasets. InstanSeg performed strongly on DAPI, ssDNA, and 10xGenomics_DAPI, but obtained a much lower score on mIF. The mIF dataset also produced lower scores for several MicroSAM variants, showing that the sustainability-aware benefit of adaptation remained dataset-dependent.
blocks.zh: 在荧光数据集中,InstanSeg实现了SAPI FT + I\mathrm{SAPI}_{\-mathrm{FT+I}}}最高的平均值. Cellpose cyto2, Cellpose cyto3和MEDIAR紧随其后. StarDist (Fluo) 也依然具有竞争力. 热图显示,在所有荧光数据集中,这些排名并不一致. InstanSeg在DAPI, ssDNA, 和10xGenomics上表现强劲_ DAPI,但在MIF上获得了更低的分数. MIF数据集也为几个微SAM变体产生了较低的分数,表明适应的可持续性-认知惠益仍然依赖于数据集.

blocks.en: A similar pattern appeared on the two H&E datasets. InstanSeg obtained the highest average score, followed by MEDIAR. Cellpose cyto2, Cellpose cyto3, and StarDist (H&E) also achieved strong results. In contrast, the larger PathoSAM and CellViT variants generally received lower scores, despite their competitive adapted performance because their additional energy and model-complexity costs were not fully offset by their performance gains.
blocks.zh: 两个H&E数据集也出现了类似的模式. InstanSeg获得了最高的平均分,其次是MEDIAR. Cellpose cyto2, Cellpose cyto3,和StarDist(H&E)也取得了很强的成果. 相形之下,较大的PathoSAM和CellViT变体的分数一般较低,尽管它们具有竞争性的适应性,因为它们额外的能耗和模型复杂性成本并没有被它们的性能收益所完全抵消.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning also changed the relative SAPI \mathrm{SAPI} ranking of several models. In the zero-shot setting, StarDist (Fluo) and MEDIAR ranked among the strongest models because they combined competitive segmentation performance with low inference energy and small model size. After few-shot adaptation, InstanSeg moved to the highest average SAPI FT + I \mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{FT+I}} score across both fluorescence and H&E datasets, while Cellpose cyto2 and cyto3 also improved their relative positions. This shift reflects the effect of adaptation on both segmentation performance and the total energy cost considered by SAPI FT + I \mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{FT+I}} . Models that gained substantially in segmentation performance could therefore improve their sustainability-aware ranking, whereas models with high adaptation or inference costs remained disadvantaged despite competitive adapted performance. The results show that the most favourable model under zero-shot inference is not necessarily the most favourable model after target-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 微调还改变了相对的SAPI\mathrm{SAPI}数个型号的排名. 在零镜头设定中,StarDist (Fluo)和MEDIAR在最强模型中排名一等,因为它们将竞争性分块性能与低推断能和小模型大小相结合. 经过了几发的适应后,InstanSeg移动到最高平均水平的SAPI FT + I\mathrm{SAPI}_{\-mathrm{FT+I}}在荧光和H&E数据集上的分数,而Cellpose cyto2和cyto3也改善了相对位置. 这一转变反映了适应对分解性能和SAPI FT + I\mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{FT+I}}所考虑的总能耗的影响. 因此,在分化绩效方面大幅提高的模型可以提高其可持续性意识的排名,而适应或推论成本高的模型尽管具有竞争性的适应性,但仍然处于不利地位。 结果显示,零发推论下最有利的模型不一定是目标特异性改造后最有利的模型.

blocks.en: Overall, the results favor models that achieve a suitable balance between segmentation performance, adaptation cost, inference cost, and model complexity. No model achieved the highest score on every dataset, and some models showed markedly different results across image modalities. Nevertheless, InstanSeg remains the most sustainable model on an average across all the datasets, followed by MEDIAR and then the two Cellpose cyto variants. The choice of model should therefore reflect both the target dataset and the sustainability requirements of the intended deployment scenario.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果有利于在分化性能、适应成本、推论成本和模型复杂性之间实现适当平衡的模型。 没有模型在每一个数据集上都取得了最高分分,一些模型显示不同图像模式的结果明显不同. 尽管如此,InstanSeg仍然是所有数据集平均最可持续的模型,其次是MEDIAR,然后是两个Cellpose细胞变体。 因此,模型的选择应既反映目标数据集,也反映预期部署情景的可持续性要求。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: This study examined whether the segmentation gains from large pre-trained and foundation models were proportionate to their computational requirements. We evaluated 19 model configurations across six CellBinDB datasets and considered segmentation performance, inference energy, fine-tuning energy, and model complexity. Three findings define the main narrative of the study. First, increasing model size did not lead to a consistent or proportional improvement in segmentation performance. Second, large foundation models often achieved a marginally higher performance, but they required order of magnitude more energy and trainable parameters. Third, several compact models remained competitive and provided a better balance between segmentation quality and computational cost. These results show that the model with the highest segmentation score is not necessarily the most suitable model for resource constrained deployment scenarios.
blocks.zh: 这项研究审查了大型预先培训和基础模型的分解收益是否与其计算要求相称。 我们评价了19个模型配置,覆盖了6个CellBinDB数据集,并审议了分解性能,推断能,微调能,以及模型复杂性. 三项结论确定了研究的主要叙述. 首先,模型规模的扩大并没有导致分化性能的一致或比例的改善. 第二,大型基础模型的性能往往略高,但它们需要更大的能量和可训练参数。 第三,一些紧凑的模型仍然具有竞争力,为分割质量和计算成本提供了更好的平衡。 这些结果表明,分化分数最高的模型不一定是资源受限部署情景的最合适模型.

blocks.en: The main issue is therefore proportionality. A larger computational burden is reasonable when it produces a clear and practically important improvement. However, a marginal performance gain may not justify a large increase in inference energy, adaptation cost, or model complexity. The decision depends on the intended application. A marginal gain may be important when it prevents a consequential segmentation error, but it may have limited value when competing models already meet the required performance level. These findings support the Green AI principle that predictive quality and computational efficiency should be evaluated together [ 12 , 15 ] . Our study extends this principle to cell and nuclear instance segmentation through a controlled comparison of predictive performance, energy use, and model complexity.
blocks.zh: 因此,主要问题是相称性。 更大的计算负担,如果能产生明确和实际上重要的改进,就是合理的。 然而,边际性能增益可能不能成为大量增加推断能量、适应成本或模型复杂性的理由。 决定取决于预定的申请。 边际收益在防止相继分化出错时可能很重要,但当相竞争的模型已经达到所要求的性能水平时,其价值可能有限. 这些调查结果支持绿色AI原则,即预测质量和计算效率应一起评价[12,15]. 我们的研究通过对预测性能、能量使用和模型复杂性进行有控制的比较,将这一原则延伸至细胞和核实例分化。

blocks.en: 4.1 Model scale did not determine segmentation performance
blocks.zh: 4.1 模型比额表没有确定分解性能

blocks.en: The results do not support a simple relationship between parameter count and segmentation quality. Several large pre-trained and foundation models performed strongly, but their advantage varied across datasets and adaptation settings. Smaller architectures also remained competitive across multiple datasets. Model size alone therefore provided limited information about the performance that a model would achieve on a specific cell or nuclear segmentation task.
blocks.zh: 结果不支持参数计数和分化质量之间的简单关系. 一些经过预先培训的大型基础模型表现强劲,但其优势因数据集和适应环境而异。 规模较小的架构在多个数据集中也仍然具有竞争力。 因此,单是模型规模就只能提供有限的信息,说明一个模型在特定细胞或核分裂任务上能达到的性能。

blocks.en: This result reflects the demands of instance segmentation in biomedical images. A model must separate densely packed and touching objects, preserve fine boundaries, and remain robust to changes in staining, tissue structure, image contrast, object density, and imaging modality. Generic visual representations do not automatically satisfy these requirements. Performance also depends on the correspondence between the pre-training domain and the target images, the model architecture, the instance-separation method, the inference procedure, and the model-specific pre-processing and post-processing steps.
blocks.zh: 这一结果反映了生物医学图像对实例分解的要求。 模型必须把密集包装和触摸的物体分开,保持细细的界限,并保持坚固,以适应污渍、组织结构、图像对比、物体密度和成像方式的变化。 一般视觉表现不能自动满足这些要求。 性能还取决于训练前域与目标图像,模型架构,实例分离方法,推论程序,以及模型特定预处理和后处理步骤之间的对应.

blocks.en: Large-scale pre-training can still provide useful representations. Foundation models may transfer across datasets and can support tasks that are not measured in this benchmark, including prompted segmentation and reuse across several applications [ 8 , 45 ] . Their broader capabilities may justify their size when a single shared model replaces several specialized systems or supports a wide range of workloads. However, these benefits should be demonstrated for the intended deployment setting. For a fixed and repetitive segmentation task, a specialized model may provide a better balance when the additional capabilities of a general-purpose model remain unused.
blocks.zh: 大规模预训仍能提供有用的表述. 基础模型可跨数据集传输,并可支持本基准中未计量的任务,包括若干应用程序的激发分解和再利用[8,45]。 当一个单一的共享模式取代若干专门系统或支持各种工作量时,它们更广泛的能力可能证明它们的规模是合理的。 然而,这些好处应表现在预定的部署环境中。 对于固定的和重复的分化任务,在普通用途模型的额外能力仍未得到利用时,专门模型可提供更好的平衡。

blocks.en: The results also show why parameter count and measured energy should not be treated as equivalent measures. Parameter count describes model scale and influences hardware requirements, but it does not fully determine computational cost. Energy use also depends on activation sizes, operator types, memory transfers, numerical precision, image tiling, prompt generation, post-processing, framework overhead, and hardware utilization. A model with fewer parameters may therefore consume more energy than its size suggests. Conversely, a larger architecture may use the hardware more efficiently. Direct energy measurements provide stronger evidence for deployment decisions than parameter count alone. Energy and complexity should therefore be reported as related but distinct properties.
blocks.zh: 结果还表明,为什么参数计算和测量的能量不应作为等同的计量标准。 参数计数描述了模型尺度并影响了硬件要求,但它并没有完全确定计算成本. 能源使用还取决于激活大小、操作员类型、内存转移、数字精度、图像平板、即时生成、后处理、框架间接费用和硬件利用。 因此,参数较少的模型可能消耗的能量比其规模所显示的要多. 相反,更大的架构可能更有效率地使用硬件。 直接能源测量为部署决定提供了比参数本身更强有力的证据。 因此,应将能源和复杂性报告为相关但又截然不同的特性。

blocks.en: Large-scale pre-training often improve cell and nuclear segmentation. However, the additional performance was usually accompanied by greater inference energy and a much larger parameter footprint. The relevant question is therefore not only whether a foundation model performs better, but whether the size of the improvement justifies the additional recurring costs.
blocks.zh: 大规模前期训练往往能改善细胞分化和核分化. 然而,附加性能通常伴随着更大的推断能和更大的参数足迹. 因此,相关问题不仅在于基础模式是否发挥得更好,而且在于改进的规模是否证明需要增加经常性费用。

blocks.en: This distinction is especially important for inference. Fine-tuning normally occurs a limited number of times, whereas inference may be repeated over thousands or millions of images. A difference that appears small at the level of one image can become substantial in a high-volume pipeline. Repeated inference affects energy consumption, processing time, accelerator availability, infrastructure requirements, cooling demand, and the number of analyses that can run concurrently. These effects are relevant to digital pathology, spatial biology, fluorescence microscopy, and high-content screening, where segmentation is often applied to large image collections.
blocks.zh: 这种区分对于推论特别重要. 微调通常发生次数有限,而推论可能重复上千或上百万个图像。 在一幅图像上看似很小的差别,在高容量的管道中可能变得很大。 反复推论影响能耗,加工时间,加速器可用性,基础设施要求,冷却需求,以及能够同时运行的分析数量等. 这些效果与数字病理学,空间生物学,荧光显微镜,高含量筛选有关,其中分化常被应用于大型图像集.

blocks.en: The practical importance of the performance gain must therefore guide model selection. A more computationally demanding model may be justified when it corrects errors that affect downstream measurements, biological conclusions, or clinical interpretation. In contrast, the lower-cost model is usually more preferable when two models produce results that are sufficiently similar for the intended task. This does not mean that energy should take priority over segmentation quality. Candidate models should first meet a task-specific performance requirement. Models that satisfy this requirement can then be compared using inference energy, runtime, memory demand, parameter count, maintainability, and hardware accessibility.
blocks.zh: 因此,业绩收益的实际重要性必须指导模型的选择。 更具有计算要求的模型在纠正影响下游测量、生物结论或临床解释的错误时可能是合理的。 相形之下,当两种模式产生与预定任务足够相近的结果时,成本较低的模式通常更为可取. 这并不意味着能源应优先于分化质量。 候选人模式应首先满足具体任务的业绩要求。 然后,可以使用推论能量,运行时间,内存需求,参数计数,可维护性,以及硬件的可访问性来比较满足这一要求的模型.

blocks.en: This approach avoids two problematic choices. It prevents the selection of an inadequate model only because it consumes less energy. It also prevents a marginal performance gain from automatically outweighing a much larger computational burden. The appropriate weight will differ between applications and should reflect the consequences of segmentation errors in the downstream workflow.
blocks.zh: 这种办法避免了两个有问题的选择。 它只因为它消耗了较少的能量,所以无法选择不适当的模型. 这也阻止了边际性能收益自动超过更大的计算负担. 适当的权重将因应用程序的不同而不同,并应反映下游工作流程中分化错误的后果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Few-shot adaptation should be justified by its incremental benefit
blocks.zh: 4.2 少许迅速的适应应以其增益为理由

blocks.en: The comparison between zero-shot inference, frozen-encoder adaptation, and full-model fine-tuning shows that adaptation should be treated as a deployment investment. Fine-tuning can improve the alignment between a pre-trained model and a target dataset. However, the gain should be evaluated against the required annotation effort, training energy, memory demand, and implementation complexity. Full-model fine-tuning is difficult to justify when it provides only a tiny improvement over zero-shot inference or frozen-encoder adaptation.
blocks.zh: 将零发推论,冷凝编码器改造,全模式微调等进行比较后发现,适应应被视作部署投资. 精细调整可以改善预训模型与目标数据集的对接. 然而,应对照所需说明、培训能量、记忆需要和执行的复杂性来评价收益。 完全模型的微调在仅比零发推论或冷冻编码器的调取提供微小改进的情况下,是难以证明的.

blocks.en: Frozen-encoder adaptation can provide a useful compromise. It updates only part of the model and can reduce the computational and memory requirements of training. It may work well when the pre-trained encoder already provides suitable representations for the target images. However, freezing the encoder can restrict adaptation when the target modality differs substantially from the pre-training domain. The relative value of frozen and full adaptation therefore depends on both the model and the dataset. Our results do not establish one adaptation strategy as universally superior.
blocks.zh: 冷冻-编码器改造可以提供有用的妥协. 它只更新了部分模型,可以减少训练的计算和内存要求. 如果预先训练的编码器已经为目标图像提供了适当的表示,则可能效果良好. 然而,当目标模式与培训前域有很大差异时,冻结编码器可以限制适应. 因此,被冻结和完全适应的相对价值取决于模型和数据集。 我们的成果并没有确立一个普遍优越的适应战略。

blocks.en: The controlled few-shot protocol is important for this interpretation. Each model received the same tissue-stratified support set and the same training budget. This design allowed us to compare how efficiently different models used a limited support set. It did not attempt to find the maximum possible performance of every architecture. Model-specific tuning of the learning rate, augmentation, training duration, or support-set size could improve some results. However, such optimization would require additional computation and would reduce comparability between models. The benchmark instead addresses a practical question: under the same limited annotation and adaptation budget, which models convert these resources into useful performance gains most effectively?
blocks.zh: 受控的几发协议对这一解释很重要. 每个模型都得到同样的组织级支助和同样的培训预算。 这种设计使我们能够比较不同模型如何高效地使用有限的支持集. 它没有试图找到每个建筑的最大性能. 针对具体模式的学习率调整、增强、培训期限或支助规模可改善一些成果。 然而,这种优化将需要额外的计算,并会降低模型之间的可比性。 基准涉及一个实际问题:在同一有限的说明和适应预算之下,哪些模型将这些资源最有效地转化为有用的业绩收益?

blocks.en: The value of adaptation also depends on how often the resulting model will be used. An expensive fine-tuning procedure may be reasonable when it produces a meaningful improvement and the adapted model is then applied to a large number of images. The same procedure may be less attractive when models must be retrained frequently for different sites, staining protocols, tissues, or imaging devices. Adaptation and inference costs should therefore be interpreted in relation to the expected deployment volume.
blocks.zh: 适应的价值还取决于所产生的模型将使用多少次。 一个昂贵的微调程序,如果能够产生有意义的改进,然后将经过改造的模型应用于大量图像,可能是合理的. 当模型必须经常为不同地点、污渍协议、组织或成像装置重新训练时,同样的程序可能不那么具有吸引力。 因此,适应和推断费用应结合预期部署量加以解释。

blocks.en: The SAPI FT + I \mathrm{SAPI}_{\mathrm{FT+I}} formulation makes this distinction explicit by combining fine-tuning and post-fine-tuning inference energy. The parameter λ \lambda controls their relative contribution. A larger value gives more importance to recurring inference, while a smaller value gives greater importance to adaptation. This weighting represents an assumed deployment pattern rather than a complete lifecycle model. It should therefore be selected and reported according to the expected use of the adapted model.
blocks.zh: SAPI FT + I\mathrm{ SAPI}_{\-mathrm{FT+I}} 配方通过将微调和后细调推想能量相结合来明确区分. 参数 QQ\lambda 控制它们的相对贡献. 更大的价值更需要反复推断,而较小的价值更需要适应。 这种加权表示一种假定的部署模式,而不是完整的生命周期模式。 因此,应当根据经过调整的模型的预期用途进行选择和报告。

blocks.en: 4.3 SAPI makes the performance-resource trade-off explicit
blocks.zh: 4.3 SAPI明确了业绩资源取舍

blocks.en: No single measurement was sufficient to identify the most appropriate model. A ranking based only on segmentation performance favors the most accurate models without considering the resources they require. A ranking based only on energy or parameter count favors compact models even when their segmentation quality is insufficient. The joint analysis of performance, energy, and model size showed that models occupied different positions across these dimensions.
blocks.zh: 没有单一的衡量方法足以确定最合适的模式。 仅基于分化性能的排名有利于最准确的模型,而不考虑它们所需要的资源. 仅仅基于能或参数的排名会有利于紧凑模型,即使它们的分化质量不够. 对性能、能能和模型规模的联合分析表明,模型在这些方面占据不同位置。

blocks.en: The Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI) addresses this problem by combining the three dimensions in a transparent manner. Under the default weights, ( α \alpha =1/2, β \beta =1/3, and γ \gamma =1/6), performance, energy, and complexity have a relative importance of (3:2:1). Performance receives the greatest weight because segmentation quality remains the primary requirement. Energy receives the second-largest weight because inference can create a recurring operational cost. Parameter count receives the smallest weight but still captures relevant constraints related to storage, memory, model transfer, and access to suitable hardware.
blocks.zh: 可持续性-认知性能指数以透明的方式将三个层面结合起来,以此解决这一问题。 在默认的权重下,(α\α=1/2,β\β=1/3和γ\γ=1/6),性能,能和复杂性相对重要(3:2:1)。 业绩的分量最大,因为分化质量仍然是首要要求。 能源得到的重量是第二多,因为推论会造成经常性的业务费用。 参数计数得到的重量最小,但仍能捕捉到与存储,内存,模型传输,以及获取合适的硬件相关的限制.

blocks.en: This weighting does not reward low energy use at the expense of inadequate segmentation. Instead, it assesses whether the achieved performance is proportionate to the required energy and model complexity. A compact model can rank favorably when it achieves competitive performance at substantially lower cost. A larger model can also rank highly when its performance advantage is sufficiently large to compensate for its greater resource consumption.
blocks.zh: 这种权重不能奖励低能耗而牺牲分化不足. 相反,它评估所取得的成绩是否与所需的能量和模型复杂性相称。 一个紧凑的模型,如果能以低得多的成本取得有竞争力的绩效,就能够优先排序。 较大的模型如果其性能优势足够大,足以补偿其更大的资源消耗,也可以排出高位.

blocks.en: SAPI does not define a universal and permanent ordering of models. Its ranking depends on the priorities expressed through the weights. A high-throughput laboratory may assign more importance to inference energy. An application with severe consequences for segmentation errors may place greater emphasis on performance. A resource-constrained setting may give additional importance to model complexity. A change in ranking under different weights is therefore not a failure of the SAPI index. Instead, it shows that the preferred model depends on the intended use case.
blocks.zh: SAPI没有定义通用和永久的模型订单. 其排名取决于通过权重表达的优先事项. 高通量实验室可能更加重视推论能. 对分解错误造成严重后果的申请可能更加重视业绩。 资源受限的设置可能更加重视模型的复杂性。 因此,不同权重下的排名变化并不是SAPI指数的失败. 相反,这表明首选模式取决于预期用途。

blocks.en: 4.4 Energy consumption and implications for operational carbon emissions
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 能源消耗及其对实际碳排放的影响

blocks.en: Energy consumption has direct implications for the operational carbon emissions associated with computation. Electricity-related operational emissions depend on the energy consumed and the carbon intensity of the electricity supplying the computation. Under the same electricity and data-center conditions, a proportional increase in energy consumption therefore produces a proportional increase in operational emissions. This makes energy efficiency an important consideration when selecting models for deployment.
blocks.zh: 能源消耗对与计算有关的碳排放的运行有直接影响。 与电力有关的运行排放取决于所消耗的能耗和提供计算的电力的碳密度。 因此,在相同的电力和数据中心条件下,能源消耗量的成比例增加会导致运行排放量成比例地增加。 这使能源效率成为选择部署模式的重要考虑因素。

blocks.en: The implications become more substantial as computational workloads increase. A small difference in energy per image can accumulate when a model processes thousands or millions of images or is deployed continuously across multiple sites. This is particularly relevant for high-throughput applications such as digital pathology, biopharmaceutical screening, and large-scale microscopy analysis. When models provide only marginal performance gains but require substantially more computation, the additional energy demand can translate into a corresponding increase in electricity related operational emissions. Fine-tuning and repeated model adaptation add further computational demand and should therefore also be considered when evaluating the overall resource requirements of a model.
blocks.zh: 随着计算工作量的增加,其影响变得更加重大。 当一个模型处理上千或上百万个图像或连续部署在多个站点时,每个图像的能耗会有小的差别会累积. 这对于数字病理学,生药筛选等高通量应用,以及大规模显微镜分析尤其有现实意义. 当模型只提供边际性能收益,但需要大量计算时,额外的能源需求可转化为电力相关运行排放的相应增加. 精细调整和重复的模型适应增加了进一步的计算需求,因此在评价模型的总体资源需求时也应当考虑.

blocks.en: Carbon-aware practices can reduce the emissions associated with a given computational workload by using electricity with lower carbon intensity or shifting computation to periods when cleaner electricity is available. These measures can complement improvements in model and workflow efficiency, which directly reduce the amount of computation required. The energy results reported in this study should, however, not be interpreted as a complete environmental assessment. They quantify computational demand within the defined experimental setting and do not capture embodied emissions from hardware and infrastructure or the energy and emissions associated with pre-training externally developed models. Our results, therefore, provide an important indicator of the potential operational carbon implications of model choice.
blocks.zh: 碳意识做法可以通过使用碳强度较低的电力或将计算转移到有更清洁电力的时期来减少与特定计算工作量相关的排放。 这些措施可以补充模型和工作流程效率的提高,这直接减少了需要的计算量. 然而,本研究报告所汇报的能源成果不应被解释为一项完整的环境评估。 它们将计算需求量化于确定的实验环境之内,没有反映硬件和基础设施的排放量或与外部开发的培训前模型有关的能量和排放量。 因此,我们的成果提供了一个重要的指标,说明模型选择对碳的潜在操作影响。

blocks.en: 4.5 Implications for sustainable biomedical image segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.5 对可持续生物医学图像分解的影响

blocks.en: Our findings have direct implications for the design and deployment of biomedical image-segmentation systems. Cell and nuclear segmentation often forms an early stage of a larger analytical pipeline. Its outputs may be used for feature extraction, cell counting, spatial analysis, population statistics, phenotypic profiling, treatment-response modeling, or quality control. The value of a performance improvement should therefore be judged by its effect on these downstream analyses rather than by the segmentation score alone.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果直接影响到生物医学图像分区系统的设计和部署。 细胞和核分解常常形成一个更大的分析管道的早期阶段. 其产出可用于地物提取、细胞计数、空间分析、人口统计、中相剖析、处理-反应模型或质量控制。 因此,业绩改进的价值应根据其对这些下游分析的影响来判断,而不应仅以分分分分分来判断。

blocks.en: This consideration is particularly important in high-content screening, drug discovery, toxicology, spatial biology, and large microscopy studies. These applications may process large numbers of images across many experimental conditions. A small increase in per-image energy or runtime can accumulate over the full workload. A more expensive model may also reduce throughput or require additional accelerators. The resulting infrastructure burden may limit the number of samples, compounds, tissues, or experimental conditions that can be analyzed within a fixed budget.
blocks.zh: 在高含量筛选、药物发现、毒理学、空间生物学和大型显微镜研究中,这种考虑特别重要。 这些应用可能在许多实验条件下处理大量图像. 每幅图像的能耗或运行时间略有增加,可在全部工作量中积累。 更昂贵的模型还可能减少吞吐量或需要额外的加速器. 由此产生的基础设施负担可能限制可在固定预算范围内分析的样品、化合物、组织或实验条件的数量。

blocks.en: Our results indicate that researchers should not select the largest available model by default. They should first define the minimum segmentation quality required by the downstream task. Among models that meet this requirement, they should prefer the model that provides the most favorable balance of inference energy, adaptation energy, runtime, memory use, parameter count, and maintenance effort. This approach makes computational cost part of the model-selection process.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,研究人员不应默认选择现有最大的模型。 它们应首先确定下游任务所要求的最低分化质量。 在符合这一要求的模型中,它们应当倾向于提供推论能、适应能、运行时间、内存使用、参数计数和维护努力的最有利平衡的模型。 这种方法使计算成本成为模型选择过程的一部分.

blocks.en: Model developers should also report efficiency measurements alongside segmentation results. Parameter count alone is not sufficient. Studies should report measured inference energy, runtime, memory use, hardware, numerical precision, image size, tiling strategy, and relevant pre-processing and post-processing boundaries. Fine-tuning studies should additionally report the training budget and the energy required for adaptation. These details are necessary for making informed decisions about using the model.
blocks.zh: 模型开发者还应报告效率测量和分解结果。 单靠参数计数是不够的。 研究应当报告测量到的推断能,运行时间,内存使用,硬件,数值精度,图像大小,平板策略,以及相关的预处理和后处理边界. 精细调整研究应当再上报培训预算和适应所需的能耗. 这些细节对于就使用该模型作出知情决定是必要的。

blocks.en: Adaptation strategies should follow the same principle. Full-model fine-tuning should not be treated as the automatic choice. Frozen-encoder adaptation may be preferable when it achieves a similar improvement at lower energy cost. Zero-shot inference may remain the most suitable option when adaptation provides marginal benefit. The selected strategy should depend on the incremental performance gain, the frequency of retraining, and the expected number of future inferences.
blocks.zh: 适应战略应遵循同样的原则。 完全型型的微调不应被视为自动选择. 当冷冻-编码器以更低的能耗实现类似改进时,其适应性可能更好. 在适应提供边际利益时,零发推论可能仍然是最合适的选择。 选定的战略应取决于增量的业绩收益、再培训的频率以及未来推断的预期数量。

blocks.en: Our findings are also relevant to shared research infrastructures and institutions with limited access to high-memory accelerators. A compact model that runs on widely available hardware may support broader reproduction and adoption, even when its performance is marginally below that of the largest model. Computational accessibility affects which laboratories can use a model, the size of the studies they can conduct, and their ability to reproduce published results. Efficiency is therefore connected not only to environmental sustainability but also to scientific accessibility.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果也与共享的研究基础设施和机构有关,它们接触高温加速器的机会有限。 一个紧凑的模型可以广泛使用硬件,可以支持更广泛的复制和采用,即使其性能略低于最大模型。 计算可获取性影响到哪些实验室可以使用模型,它们可以进行的研究的规模,以及它们复制所发表结果的能力。 因此,效率不仅与环境可持续性有关,而且与科学的可获取性有关。

blocks.en: A foundation model may still provide the best system-level solution when it supports several modalities or tasks and removes the need to maintain separate specialized models. In that case, the relevant comparison should include the full anticipated workload. The cost of one shared model should be compared with the combined cost and maintenance burden of the systems it replaces. Our benchmark does not directly measure this multi-task value, but it shows that broad capability should not be assumed to compensate automatically for high recurring cost.
blocks.zh: 一个基础模型在支持几种模式或任务并消除保持单独的专门模型的需要时,仍然可能提供最好的系统级解决方案. 在这种情况下,有关的比较应包括预期的全部工作量。 应将一个共同模式的费用与其所取代的系统的合并费用和维修负担进行比较。 我们的基准不直接衡量这一多任务价值,但它表明,不应假定有广泛能力自动补偿高经常性费用。

blocks.en: For clinical and translational applications, computational efficiency can influence processing time, local hardware requirements, service capacity, and maintainability. However, this study did not evaluate clinical decision-making, patient outcomes, regulatory requirements, or prospective workflow performance. Our results concern computational and operational suitability. Any clinical application would still require external validation, detailed failure analysis, robustness testing, and prospective evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对于临床和翻译应用,计算效率可以影响处理时间,本地硬件需求,服务能力,以及可维护性. 然而,这项研究没有评估临床决策、病人结果、监管要求或预期工作流程绩效。 我们的结果涉及计算和业务是否合适。 任何临床应用仍然需要外部验证、详细的故障分析、稳健性测试和前景评估。

blocks.en: The broader implication is that sustainable model selection does not mean selecting the model with the lowest energy consumption. It means using computational resources in proportion to the value they provide. The most suitable model is one that meets the required performance standard without imposing an unnecessary computational burden and adaptation cost.
blocks.zh: 更广泛的含义是,可持续的模型选择并不意味着选择能量消耗最低的模型。 这意味着按照计算资源所提供的价值的比例使用这些资源。 最合适的模式是符合要求的性能标准,而不强加不必要的计算负担和适应费用。

blocks.en: 4.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.6 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations affect the interpretation of our results. First, we performed the measurements on one fixed GPU and CPU configuration. This choice controlled hardware variation and supported consistent comparisons. However, absolute energy consumption may differ across accelerators, numerical precisions, software environments, and deployment platforms. Relative efficiency may also change when an architecture is better optimized for a different hardware system. The reported energy values are therefore empirical measurements for the evaluated configuration rather than fixed properties of the model architectures.
blocks.zh: 有几个限制影响对我们结果的解释。 首先,我们对一个固定的GPU和CPU配置进行了测量. 此选择控制了硬件变异,并支持一致的比较. 然而,在加速器、数字精度、软件环境和部署平台方面,绝对能耗可能有所不同。 当一个架构对不同的硬件系统进行更好的优化时,相对的效率也可能发生变化. 因此,所报告的能值是对模型结构的评估配置的经验性测量,而不是固定的特性。

blocks.en: Second, the benchmark covers operational energy within defined inference and fine-tuning boundaries. It does not include the energy consumed during the original pre-training of the published checkpoints. Reliable checkpoint-specific pre-training information was not available for all models.
blocks.zh: 第二,基准涵盖确定推断和微调界限内的业务能。 它不包括在公布的检查站最初的预训期间所消耗的能量。 并非所有模式都具备针对检查站的可靠培训前信息。

blocks.en: Third, the fixed adaptation protocol was designed to enable controlled comparison across models rather than maximize the performance of each model individually. The use of limited support sets, a fixed training duration, and no validation-based early stopping ensures that all models are evaluated under the same adaptation conditions, but may favor models that adapt efficiently within these constraints. Model-specific optimization, such as using additional support images, longer training, different learning-rate schedules, or model-specific augmentation, could improve the performance of individual models. However, such optimization would introduce additional sources of variation, increase computational cost, and make direct comparisons across models less controlled.
blocks.zh: 第三,固定适应议定书的设计是为了便于在模型之间进行有控制的比较,而不是使每个模型各自发挥最大的性能。 使用有限的支持装置、固定的培训期限以及没有基于验证的早期停止,可确保所有模型在相同的适应条件下得到评价,但可能倾向于在这些限制范围内有效调整的模型。 针对模型的优化,如使用额外的支持图像,更长时间的培训,不同的学习率时间表,或针对模型的增强,可以提高单个模型的性能. 然而,这种优化将增加变化来源,增加计算成本,并减少对模型的直接比较。

blocks.en: Fourth, the six CellBinDB subsets cover several imaging modalities and tissue strata, but they do not represent the full diversity of microscopy and pathology data. Differences in specimen preparation, staining, imaging devices, acquisition settings, artifacts, and disease composition may affect model performance. External evaluation on independently collected datasets is needed before extending the reported rankings to other settings. Undocumented overlap between model pre-training data and the source data underlying a benchmark may also be difficult to exclude for externally developed checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 第四,6个CellBinDB子集涵盖了几种成像模式和组织层,但它们并不代表了显微镜和病理学数据的全面多样性. 标本制备、污渍、成像装置、购置设置、文物和疾病组成等方面的差异可能影响模型性能。 在将报告的排名扩大到其他环境之前,需要对独立收集的数据集进行外部评价。 对于外部开发的检查站来说,可能也难以排除模式培训前数据和基准来源数据之间的无记录重叠。

blocks.en: Fifth, for the zero-shot inference experiments, we evaluated model-native automatic inference without dataset-specific threshold optimization or manual prompting. This protocol supports scalable and consistent comparison, but it may not show the maximum performance of interactive or prompt-dependent models. The conclusions therefore apply to automatic segmentation under the evaluated settings. They should not be directly extended to interactive workflows in which expert prompts or manual corrections form part of the inference process.
blocks.zh: 第五,对于零镜头推论实验,我们评价了模型-内在自动推论,而没有特定的数据集阈值优化或人工提示. 此协议支持可伸缩和一致的比较,但可能无法显示交互式或即时依赖模型的最大性能. 因此,结论适用于所评价的环境下的自动分割。 它们不应直接扩展到专家提示或人工更正构成推论过程一部分的互动工作流程。

blocks.en: Sixth, parameter count represents only one aspect of model complexity. It does not directly describe activation memory, operator efficiency, dependency management, loading time, software stability, or maintenance effort. The measured energy and memory values provide complementary information, but a complete deployment analysis would also require throughput testing, reliability assessment, hardware cost, and integration with the intended analytical system.
blocks.zh: 第六,参数计数只是模型复杂性的一个方面. 它没有直接描述激活内存,操作效率,依赖性管理,加载时间,软件稳定性,或维护工作. 所测量的能量和内存值提供了补充信息,但全面的部署分析还需要吞吐量测试、可靠性评估、硬件成本以及与预期分析系统的整合。

blocks.en: Finally, SAPI contains explicit choices. The weights assigned to performance, energy, and parameter count, and the value of λ \lambda affect the resulting ranking. The index is configurable so that these choices can reflect different deployment priorities. However, every application should state and justify its selected weights. SAPI rankings should always be reported together with its component weights.
blocks.zh: 最后,SAPI包含了明确的选择. 分配给性能,能,和参数计数的权重,以及QQ\lambda的值会影响由此产生的排名. 该指数是可以描述的,以便这些选择能够反映不同的部署优先事项。 然而,每项申请都应说明其选定的权重并说明理由。 SAPI的排名应始终连同其组成部分权重一起报告.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This study presents a sustainability-aware benchmark of 19 pretrained cell and nuclear instance segmentation models across six CellBinDB datasets. We evaluated zero-shot inference and few-shot adaptation using segmentation performance, operational energy consumption, and model size. Our results show that these factors vary substantially across models and datasets, and that higher performance does not always justify greater computational cost. Model selection should therefore consider image modality, adaptation needs, deployment scale, and resource use rather than segmentation accuracy alone.
blocks.zh: 这项研究提出了对可持续能力的认识基准,即跨越6个细胞BinDB数据集的19个预先训练的细胞和核实例分解模型。 我们利用分解性能、业务能消耗和模型大小,评估了零发推论和几发调整。 我们的结果显示,这些因素因模型和数据集而相去甚远,而且业绩提高并不总是有理由提高计算成本。 因此,模型选择应考虑图像模式、适应需要、部署规模和资源利用,而不应仅考虑分化准确性。

blocks.en: We introduced SAPI, a novel measure, to provide a transparent way to examine the trade-offs between performance, energy use, and model complexity. The explicit weightage assigned to each component of SAPI allows researchers and practitioners to adjust the weighting according to their priorities, providing a practical framework for selecting cell segmentation models that are both effective and efficient.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SAPI, 这是一种新的措施, 提供透明的方法来检查性能、能源使用和模型复杂性之间的权衡。 给SAPI的每个组件分配的明确权重使研究人员和从业者能够根据自己的优先顺序来调整权重,为选择既有效又高效的细胞分化模型提供了一个实用的框架.

blocks.en: This supplementary material provides additional information on model and software, together with detailed quantitative and qualitative results. The experimental protocol, metric definitions, energy measurement procedure, carbon-emission calculation, and formulation of the Sustainable AI Performance Index are described in the main manuscript. Unless stated otherwise, quantitative results report the mean across ten runs. Qualitative zero-shot examples use the experiment associated with random seed 0.
blocks.zh: 这份补充材料提供了关于模型和软件的补充信息,以及详细的定量和定性结果。 主要手稿介绍了实验协议、计量定义、能源测量程序、碳排放计算以及可持续AI性能指数的制定。 除非另有说明,量化结果报告平均为10起。 定性零射出的例子使用与随机种子0相关的实验.

blocks.en: We evaluated each pre-trained model without dataset-specific adaptation. Each model was assessed only on datasets compatible with its intended image modality. The main manuscript reports the composite performance score ( P P ), whereas Figures S1 , S2 and S3 provide the corresponding AJI+, Panoptic Quality (PQ), and Normalized Surface Dice (NSD) results.

blocks.en: A.3 Few-Shot Adaptation
blocks.zh: A.3 少数热量适应

blocks.en: We grouped the images in a dataset by tissue and sampled one image from every tissue group to form the support set for fine-tuning. The remaining images formed the test set. We first evaluated each compatible model on this test set before adaptation and then evaluated it again after fine-tuning on the support set. Fine-tuning was performed for 100 epochs under two regimes: full-model fine-tuning, in which all the model parameters were updated, and frozen-encoder fine-tuning, in which the encoder weights were not updated during training. We repeated the complete procedure ten times using random seeds 0–9.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个数据组将图像按组织分类, 从每个组织组中抽取一个图像, 形成微调的支持集。 所剩影像组成了测试集. 我们首先在本测试集上评价了每个相容模型,然后在调整了支持集后再次评价. 在两个制度下对100个时代进行了微调:全模微调,其中更新了所有模型参数;冷冻-编码器微调,其中在训练期间没有更新编码器重量. 我们用0到9号种子重复了十次完整的程序。
